3.69.s:
3.341
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca proktā dharmāstvayānagha ..
rahasyabhūtā ye dharmā ye ca svalpā mahāphalāḥ .. 1 ..
3.69.d:
3.341
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
वर्णानामाश्रमाणां च प्रोक्ता धर्मास्त्वयानघ ॥
रहस्यभूता ये धर्मा ये च स्वल्पा महाफलाः ॥ 1 ॥
3.69.m:
3.341
The sages said:
The dharmas of the castes and life-stages have been spoken by you, sinless one. / What dharmas are secret and require little effort yet yield great fruit,

3.69.s:
yebhyaścābhyadhikaṃ nāsti sarveṣāṃ tu samāśraye ..
tāndharmānkathayasvādya sarveṣāṃ vinatirdvija .. 2 .. ..
3.69.d:
येभ्यश्चाभ्यधिकं नास्ति सर्वेषां तु समाश्रये ॥
तान्धर्मान्कथयस्वाद्य सर्वेषां विनतिर्द्विज ॥ 2 ॥ ॥
3.69.m: and compared to which there is none higher in taking refuge for all— / speak to us today of those dharmas, [at our] bowed request, O twice-born.

3.69.s:
.. haṃsa uvāca .. ..
āśritya devadeveśaṃ jagadyoniṃ jagadgurum ..
viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtā dharmā mahāphalāḥ .. 3 ..
3.69.d:
॥ हंस उवाच ॥ ॥
आश्रित्य देवदेवेशं जगद्योनिं जगद्गुरुम् ॥
विष्णुं जिष्णुं हरिं कृष्णं कृता धर्मा महाफलाः ॥ 3 ॥
3.69.m:
Haṃsa said:
Having taken refuge in the God of gods, the womb of the universe, the teacher of the universe, / in Viṣṇu, the victorious, Hari, Kṛṣṇa, dharmas performed yield great fruit.

3.69.s:
patanāttrāyate yasmāttasmātpātreti kīrtyate ..
patatāṃ trāṇadastvekaḥ sa devo madhusūdanaḥ .. 4 ..
3.69.d:
पतनात्त्रायते यस्मात्तस्मात्पात्रेति कीर्त्यते ॥
पततां त्राणदस्त्वेकः स देवो मधुसूदनः ॥ 4 ॥
3.69.m: Because it protects from falling, it is declared to be a 'worthy vessel'. / And the one protector of those who are falling is that God Madhusūdana.

3.69.s:
smaraṇātkīrtanād dhyānānnamaskārātpradakṣiṇāt ..
tathābhistuvanādyasya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 5 ..
3.69.d:
स्मरणात्कीर्तनाद् ध्यानान्नमस्कारात्प्रदक्षिणात् ॥
तथाभिस्तुवनाद्यस्य मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥ 5 ॥
3.69.m: By remembering, reciting praise, meditating, bowing down, circumambulating, / and likewise by praising him, one is freed from all sins.

3.69.s:
kṛtvā devagṛhaṃ tasya devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ ..
rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ phalena sa tu yujyate .. 6 ..
3.69.d:
कृत्वा देवगृहं तस्य देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः ॥
राजसूयाश्वमेधानां फलेन स तु युज्यते ॥ 6 ॥
3.69.m: Having made a house of God for that God Parameṣṭhin, / one is endowed with the fruit of the Rājasūya and the horse-sacrifice.

3.69.s:
suraveśmāni yāvanti dvijendrāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..7..
3.69.d:
सुरवेश्मानि यावन्ति द्विजेन्द्राः परमाणवः ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥7॥
3.69.m: As many atoms as there are in the abode of the God, O foremost of the twice-born, / for so many thousands of years is one honored in the heavenly world.

3.69.s:
prāsāde mṛnmaye puṇyaṃ mayaitatkathitaṃ dvijāḥ ..
tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ daṇḍamaye bhavet .. 8 ..
3.69.d:
प्रासादे मृन्मये पुण्यं मयैतत्कथितं द्विजाः ॥
तस्माद्दशगुणं पुण्यं कृतं दण्डमये भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.69.m: This merit has been declared by me for an earthen temple, O twice-born; / ten times that merit is obtained for one made of wood.

3.69.s:
tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tathā śailakṛte bhavet ..
tato daśaguṇaṃ lohe tāmre śataguṇaṃ tataḥ .. 9..
3.69.d:
ततो दशगुणं पुण्यं तथा शैलकृते भवेत् ॥
ततो दशगुणं लोहे ताम्रे शतगुणं ततः ॥ 9॥
3.69.m: Ten times that merit is obtained for one made of stone; / ten times that in iron; a hundred times that in copper;

3.69.s:
sahasraguṇitaṃ raupye tasmātphalamupāśnute ..
tataḥ śatasahasraṃ ca sauvarṇe dvijasattamāḥ .. 3.341.10 ..
3.69.d:
सहस्रगुणितं रौप्ये तस्मात्फलमुपाश्नुते ॥
ततः शतसहस्रं च सौवर्णे द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 3.341.10 ॥
3.69.m: a thousandfold fruit from silver does one obtain beyond that; / and a hundred thousand times that in a golden one, O best of the twice-born.

3.69.s:
anantaphalamāpnoti ratnacitre manohare ..
pratimāṃ kārayitvā tu devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
na durgatimavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati .. 11 ..
3.69.d:
अनन्तफलमाप्नोति रत्नचित्रे मनोहरे ॥
प्रतिमां कारयित्वा तु देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ॥
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 11 ॥
3.69.m: One obtains an endless fruit in one adorned with gems and charming. / Having had an image made of the discus-bearing God of gods, / one does not meet with misfortune and goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

3.69.s:
devasya pratimāyāṃ tu yāvaṃtaḥ paramāṇavaḥ ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 12 ..
3.69.d:
देवस्य प्रतिमायां तु यावंतः परमाणवः ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 12 ॥
3.69.m: As many atoms as there are in the image of the God, / for so many thousands of years is one honored in the world of Viṣṇu.

3.69.s: prāsādavattathā tasya phalasaṃpadudāhṛtā .. 13 ..
3.69.d: प्रासादवत्तथा तस्य फलसंपदुदाहृता ॥ 13 ॥
3.69.m: Just as for the temple, so is the abundance of its fruit declared,

3.69.s:
uttarottarato divyairvinā pakveṣṭikī dvijāḥ ..
yathoktavidhinā devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya janārdanam .. 14 ..
3.69.d:
उत्तरोत्तरतो दिव्यैर्विना पक्वेष्टिकी द्विजाः ॥
यथोक्तविधिना देवं प्रतिष्ठाप्य जनार्दनम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.69.m: successively greater, with divine materials, except for baked brick, O twice-born. / Having consecrated God Janārdana according to the prescribed rule,

3.69.s:
akṣayaṃ lokamāpnoti viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..
ijyāvidhipuraskārakṛte tatra tathā bhuvam .. 15 ..
3.69.d:
अक्षयं लोकमाप्नोति विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥
इज्याविधिपुरस्कारकृते तत्र तथा भुवम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.69.m: one attains the imperishable world of Viṣṇu of immeasurable brilliance. / When made with the precedence of sacrificial rites, then indeed on earth

3.69.s:
tasyaivānucarellokastasyaivāpnoti cākṣayam ..
karoti devaprāsādaṃ yāvadvāraṃ sudhāsitam .. 16 ..
3.69.d:
तस्यैवानुचरेल्लोकस्तस्यैवाप्नोति चाक्षयम् ॥
करोति देवप्रासादं यावद्वारं सुधासितम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.69.m: his people follow him and he attains the imperishable [state]. / As many times as one makes the temple of God whitewashed with mortar,

3.69.s:
janmāntarāṇi tāvaṃti yaśasvī bhuvi jāyate ..
citraṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kārayitvā harergṛham .. 17 ..
3.69.d:
जन्मान्तराणि तावंति यशस्वी भुवि जायते ॥
चित्रं लक्षणसंयुक्तं कारयित्वा हरेर्गृहम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.69.m: for so many future births is one born renowned on earth. / Having caused a painting endowed with the proper characteristics to be made in Hari's house,

3.69.s:
gandharvalokamāpnoti bahūnyabdagaṇāni tu ...
dattvā ca gītaṃ dharmajñā gandharvaiḥ saha modate .. 18 ..
3.69.d:
गन्धर्वलोकमाप्नोति बहून्यब्दगणानि तु ॥।
दत्त्वा च गीतं धर्मज्ञा गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते ॥ 18 ॥
3.69.m: one attains the world of the Gandharvas for many cycles of years. / And offering song, O knowers of dharma, one rejoices with the Gandharvas.

3.69.s:
svayaṃ gītena saṃpūjya tasya cānucaro bhavet ..
vādyaṃ dattvā tathā viprā śakralokamavāpnuyāt ... .. 19 ..
3.69.d:
स्वयं गीतेन संपूज्य तस्य चानुचरो भवेत् ॥
वाद्यं दत्त्वा तथा विप्रा शक्रलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥॥। 19 ॥
3.69.m: Worshiping him oneself with singing, one becomes his attendant. / Offering instrumental music likewise, O brahmins, one attains the world of Śakra.

3.69.s:
svayaṃ vādyena saṃpūjya tasyaivānucaro bhaveta ..
vādyānāmapi devasya tantrīvādyaṃ sadā priyam .. 3.341.20 ..
3.69.d:
स्वयं वाद्येन संपूज्य तस्यैवानुचरो भवेत ॥
वाद्यानामपि देवस्य तन्त्रीवाद्यं सदा प्रियम् ॥ 3.341.20 ॥
3.69.m: Worshiping him oneself with instrumental music, one becomes his attendant. / Even among musical instruments, stringed music is ever dear to the God.

3.69.s:
tena saṃpūjya varadaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt ..
nṛtyaṃ dattvā tathāpnoti rudralokamasaṃśayam .. 21 ..
3.69.d:
तेन संपूज्य वरदं गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् ॥
नृत्यं दत्त्वा तथाप्नोति रुद्रलोकमसंशयम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.69.m: By worshipping the giver of boons with that, one attains leadership of the Gaṇas. / Likewise, by offering dance, one attains the world of Rudra without doubt.

3.69.s:
svayaṃ nṛtyena saṃpūjya tasyaivānucaro bhavet ..
prekṣaṇīyapradānena śakralokamavāpnuyāt. .. 22 ..
3.69.d:
स्वयं नृत्येन संपूज्य तस्यैवानुचरो भवेत् ॥
प्रेक्षणीयप्रदानेन शक्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥। 22 ॥
3.69.m: By worshipping with dance oneself, one becomes his attendant. / By offering a theatrical spectacle, one attains the world of Śakra.

3.69.s:
abhyarcanāṃ kārayitvā brahmalokaṃ prapadyate ..
toyenābhyukṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā devadevājire naraḥ .. 23 ..
3.69.d:
अभ्यर्चनां कारयित्वा ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते ॥
तोयेनाभ्युक्षणं कृत्वा देवदेवाजिरे नरः ॥ 23 ॥
3.69.m: Having caused worship to be performed, one attains the world of Brahmā. / A man who performs sprinkling with water in the courtyard of the God of gods,

3.69.s:
sarvapāpavinirmukto vāruṇaṃ lokamaśnute ..
yastu sammārjanaṃ kuryāddevadevājire naraḥ .. 24 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो वारुणं लोकमश्नुते ॥
यस्तु सम्मार्जनं कुर्याद्देवदेवाजिरे नरः ॥ 24 ॥
3.69.m: freed from all evil, enjoys the world of Varuṇa. / But the man who sweeps the courtyard of the God of gods

3.69.s:
sapāpajaṃ malaṃ dehādapāmārjati satvaraḥ ..
karoti paramāṇūnāṃ yāvatāmapamārjanam ... .. 25 ..
3.69.d:
सपापजं मलं देहादपामार्जति सत्वरः ॥
करोति परमाणूनां यावतामपमार्जनम् ॥॥। 25 ॥
3.69.m: swiftly sweeps away the stain born of sin from his body. / As many as are the atoms he sweeps away,

3.69.s:
tāvadvarṣāṇi nākasthastridaśaiḥ saha modate ..
kṛtvopalepanaṃ viṣṇorgomayenālaye naraḥ .. 26 ..
3.69.d:
तावद्वर्षाणि नाकस्थस्त्रिदशैः सह मोदते ॥
कृत्वोपलेपनं विष्णोर्गोमयेनालये नरः ॥ 26 ॥
3.69.m: for that many years he rejoices in heaven with the gods. / Having smeared the temple of Viṣṇu with cow-dung, a man

3.69.s:
gavāṃ lokamavāpnoti yatrayatrābhijā yate ..
kṛtvā ca vividhairgandhairgandharvaiḥ saha modate .. 27 ..
3.69.d:
गवां लोकमवाप्नोति यत्रयत्राभिजा यते ॥
कृत्वा च विविधैर्गन्धैर्गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते ॥ 27 ॥
3.69.m: attains the world of cows wherever he is born. / And having made beautification of the ground in the house of Hari with various perfumes,

3.69.s:
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi bhūmiśobhāṃ harergṛhe ..
gandhodakena yaḥ kuryādviṣṇorabhyukṣaṇaṃ gṛhe .. 28 ..
3.69.d:
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि भूमिशोभां हरेर्गृहे ॥
गन्धोदकेन यः कुर्याद्विष्णोरभ्युक्षणं गृहे ॥ 28 ॥
3.69.m: he rejoices with the Gandharvas for many thousands of years. / Whoever sprinkles the temple of Viṣṇu with fragrant water

3.69.s:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi gandharvaiḥ saha modate ..
dattvopakāraṃ kusumairgandharvatvamavāpnuyāt .. 29 ..
3.69.d:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते ॥
दत्त्वोपकारं कुसुमैर्गन्धर्वत्वमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 29 ॥
3.69.m: rejoices with the Gandharvas for ten thousand years. / Having given service with flowers, he attains the state of a Gandharva.

3.69.s:
puṣpatulyāni varṣāṇi divyābharaṇarūpavān ..
kṛtvā śīrṇasya saṃskāraṃ tathā deveśaveśmani..3.341.30..
3.69.d:
पुष्पतुल्यानि वर्षाणि दिव्याभरणरूपवान् ॥
कृत्वा शीर्णस्य संस्कारं तथा देवेशवेश्मनि॥3.341.30॥
3.69.m: For as many years as there are flowers, he possesses divine ornaments and beauty. / Likewise, by repairing what is dilapidated in the temple of the Lord of gods,

3.69.s:
dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
sāyaṃ prātastathā kṛtvā vāsudevasya kīrta nam..31..
3.69.d:
द्विगुणं फलमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
सायं प्रातस्तथा कृत्वा वासुदेवस्य कीर्त नम्॥31॥
3.69.m: he obtains double the fruit; here no doubt should be entertained. / Likewise, by reciting the praise of Vāsudeva evening and morning,

3.69.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ..
śayanādutthito yastu kīrttayenmadhusūdanam..32..
3.69.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
शयनादुत्थितो यस्तु कीर्त्तयेन्मधुसूदनम्॥32॥
3.69.m: freed from all evil, he is honoured in the world of heaven. / But he who, having risen from sleep, recites the praise of Madhusūdana,

3.69.s:
kīrtanāttasya pāpāni nāśamāyāntyaśeṣataḥ ...
ahorātrasya śāntiśca tathā tena kṛtā bhavet .. 33 ..
3.69.d:
कीर्तनात्तस्य पापानि नाशमायान्त्यशेषतः ॥।
अहोरात्रस्य शान्तिश्च तथा तेन कृता भवेत् ॥ 33 ॥
3.69.m: from that recitation his sins are destroyed without remainder; / and likewise, peace for the day and night is brought about by him.

3.69.s:
prabhavaścāpyanarthānāṃ nāsya syāttadaharniśam ..
kīrtanāddevadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. .. 34 ..
3.69.d:
प्रभवश्चाप्यनर्थानां नास्य स्यात्तदहर्निशम् ॥
कीर्तनाद्देवदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥ ॥ 34 ॥
3.69.m: And there will be no origin of misfortunes for him during that day and night, / from reciting the praise of the God of gods, Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour.

3.69.s:
yakṣarākṣasavetālabhūtapretavināyakāḥ ..
ḍākinyo vidravanti sma ye tathā ye ca hiṃsakāḥ .. 35 ..
3.69.d:
यक्षराक्षसवेतालभूतप्रेतविनायकाः ॥
डाकिन्यो विद्रवन्ति स्म ये तथा ये च हिंसकाः ॥ 35 ॥
3.69.m: Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, Vetālas, Bhūtas, Pretas, Vināyakas, / Ḍākinīs, and whatever harmful beings there are, flee away.

3.69.s:
sarvānarthaharaṃ tasya nāmasaṅkīrtanaṃ smṛtam ..
devadevasya nāmāni bahūnīha vidurbudhāḥ .. 36 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वानर्थहरं तस्य नामसङ्कीर्तनं स्मृतम् ॥
देवदेवस्य नामानि बहूनीह विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 36 ॥
3.69.m: Reciting his names is taught to remove all misfortunes. / The wise know that the names of the God of gods are many in this world.

3.69.s:
teṣāmanarthaśamanaṃ yadeveṣṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ ..
ekaṃ nāma japedyastu devadevasya cakriṇaḥ .. 37 ...
3.69.d:
तेषामनर्थशमनं यदेवेष्टं महात्मनः ॥
एकं नाम जपेद्यस्तु देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ॥ 37 ॥।
3.69.m: Whichever of these calms misfortunes and is dear to the great-souled one, / if one chants even a single name of the disc-bearing God of gods,

3.69.s:
sa ca pāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ..
hṛdi kṛtvā tathā kāmamabhīṣṭaṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ .. 38 ..
ekaṃ nāma japedyastu sa tānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
3.69.d:
स च पापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
हृदि कृत्वा तथा काममभीष्टं द्विजपुङ्गवाः ॥ 38 ॥
एकं नाम जपेद्यस्तु स तान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
3.69.m:
freed from evil, he is honoured in the world of heaven. / Likewise, having held in mind a desired wish, O best of the twice-born,
whoever chants even a single name attains those wishes.

3.69.s: nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ kṛtvā kṣutapraskhalanādiṣu .. 39 ..
3.69.d: नामसंकीर्तनं कृत्वा क्षुतप्रस्खलनादिषु ॥ 39 ॥
3.69.m: Having chanted [his] names upon sneezing, stumbling, and the like,

3.69.s:
viyogaṃ śīghramāpnoti sarvānarthairasaṃśayam ..
kṛtvā nāmasahasreṇa stutiṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ .. 3.341.40 ..
3.69.d:
वियोगं शीघ्रमाप्नोति सर्वानर्थैरसंशयम् ॥
कृत्वा नामसहस्रेण स्तुतिं तस्य महात्मनः ॥ 3.341.40 ॥
3.69.m: one swiftly attains separation from all misfortunes without doubt. / Having praised that great-souled one with the thousand names,

3.69.s:
viyogamāpnoti naraḥ sarvānarthairasaṃśayam ..
sāmnā ṛbhiryajurbhiśca tathaivātharvaṇena tu .. 41 ..
3.69.d:
वियोगमाप्नोति नरः सर्वानर्थैरसंशयम् ॥
साम्ना ऋभिर्यजुर्भिश्च तथैवाथर्वणेन तु ॥ 41 ॥
3.69.m: a man attains separation from all misfortunes without doubt. / By the Sāman, by the Ṛcs, by the Yajuses, and likewise by the Atharvan,

3.69.s:
kṛtvābhiṣṭavanaṃ tasya divyairārṣaistathā stavaiḥ ..
sarvānarthavinirmuktaḥ kāmānāpnoti śāśvatān .. 42 ..
3.69.d:
कृत्वाभिष्टवनं तस्य दिव्यैरार्षैस्तथा स्तवैः ॥
सर्वानर्थविनिर्मुक्तः कामानाप्नोति शाश्वतान् ॥ 42 ॥
3.69.m: having offered praise to him with divine hymns and those of the ṛṣis, / freed from all misfortunes, he attains eternal desires.

3.69.s:
abhraṣṭalakṣaṇaiḥ kṛtvā svayaṃ svaracitākṣaraiḥ ..
stavaṃ brāhmaṇaśārdūlāstasmātkāmānavāpnuyāt. ... 43 ..
3.69.d:
अभ्रष्टलक्षणैः कृत्वा स्वयं स्वरचिताक्षरैः ॥
स्तवं ब्राह्मणशार्दूलास्तस्मात्कामानवाप्नुयात्॥॥ 43 ॥
3.69.m: Having made a hymn of praise with syllables composed by oneself, free from faulty characteristics, / O tigers among brahmins, he attains [his] desires from that.

3.69.s:
na vittadānanicayairbahubhirmadhusūdanaḥ ..
tathā toṣamupāyāti yathā stotrairdvijottamāḥ .. 44 ..
3.69.d:
न वित्तदाननिचयैर्बहुभिर्मधुसूदनः ॥
तथा तोषमुपायाति यथा स्तोत्रैर्द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 44 ॥
3.69.m: Madhusūdana does not attain such satisfaction from numerous heaps of gifts of wealth, / O best of the twice-born, as he does from hymns of praise.

3.69.s:
stutiḥ pavitrā maṅgalyā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ..
sarvānarthapraśamanī devadevasya kīrtitā .. 45 ..
3.69.d:
स्तुतिः पवित्रा मङ्गल्या सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ॥
सर्वानर्थप्रशमनी देवदेवस्य कीर्तिता ॥ 45 ॥
3.69.m: Praise of the God of gods is declared to be purifying, auspicious, / destroying all evil, and quelling all misfortunes.

3.69.s:
tatkathāśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvānarthairvimucyate ..
tatstotraśravaṇātpāpaṃ jahāti sakalaṃ tathā .. 46 ..
3.69.d:
तत्कथाश्रवणं कृत्वा सर्वानर्थैर्विमुच्यते ॥
तत्स्तोत्रश्रवणात्पापं जहाति सकलं तथा ॥ 46 ॥
3.69.m: By hearing his narrative, one is liberated from all misfortunes. / Likewise, from hearing his hymn of praise, one casts off all evil.

3.69.s:
yatra viṣṇukathā divyāḥ śrutayaśca susaṃhitāḥ ..
tacchrotavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa paramaṃ padamicchatā .. 47 ..
3.69.d:
यत्र विष्णुकथा दिव्याः श्रुतयश्च सुसंहिताः ॥
तच्छ्रोतव्यं मनुष्येण परमं पदमिच्छता ॥ 47 ॥
3.69.m: Where the divine narratives of Viṣṇu and the well-composed Vedic texts [are recited], / that should be heard by a man who desires the highest state.

3.69.s:
viṣṇorāyatane dattvā tatkathāpustakaṃ naraḥ ..
brahmalokamavāpnoti bahavo vatsarāndvijāḥ .. 48 ..
3.69.d:
विष्णोरायतने दत्त्वा तत्कथापुस्तकं नरः ॥
ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति बहवो वत्सरान्द्विजाः ॥ 48 ॥
3.69.m: Having given a book of his narrative in a shrine of Viṣṇu, a man / attains the world of Brahmā for many years, O twice-born.

3.69.s:
pustakām̐śca tathaivānyānyaḥ pradadyānnarastviha ..
sārasvatamavāpnoti lokaṃ kālaṃ tathā bahu .. 49 ..
3.69.d:
पुस्तकाम्̐श्च तथैवान्यान्यः प्रदद्यान्नरस्त्विह ॥
सारस्वतमवाप्नोति लोकं कालं तथा बहु ॥ 49 ॥
3.69.m: And whatever other books a man gives here, / he attains the world of Sarasvatī for a long time.

3.69.s:
tatkathāṃ śrāvayedyastu tadbhaktānmānavottamaḥ ..
godānaphalamāpnoti sa narastena karmaṇā..3.341.50..
3.69.d:
तत्कथां श्रावयेद्यस्तु तद्भक्तान्मानवोत्तमः ॥
गोदानफलमाप्नोति स नरस्तेन कर्मणा॥3.341.50॥
3.69.m: A best of men who recites his narrative to his devotees / attains the fruit of giving a cow through that action, O man.

3.69.s:
śrāvake tu kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sa phalāṃśena yujyate..
sukṛtaṃ vācakaṃ kṛtvā devāgāre tathā naraḥ .. 51 ..
3.69.d:
श्रावके तु कृतं पुण्यं स फलांशेन युज्यते॥
सुकृतं वाचकं कृत्वा देवागारे तथा नरः ॥ 51 ॥
3.69.m: He is endowed with a share of the fruit of the merit produced in the listener. / Likewise, a man who supports a reciter of good deeds in the temple of a deity,

3.69.s:
vidyādānaphalaṃ prāpya brahmalokaṃ prapadyate ..
viṣṇuṃ śaṅkhapradānena nirvāṇaṃ lokamaśnute .. 52 ..
3.69.d:
विद्यादानफलं प्राप्य ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते ॥
विष्णुं शङ्खप्रदानेन निर्वाणं लोकमश्नुते ॥ 52 ॥
3.69.m: having attained the fruit of the gift of knowledge, reaches the world of Brahmā. / By presenting a conch to Viṣṇu, he enjoys the world of liberation.

3.69.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya tathā khyātaśabdaśca jāyate ..
ghaṇṭāpradānena tathā mahadyaśa upāśnute.. 53 ..
3.69.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य तथा ख्यातशब्दश्च जायते ॥
घण्टाप्रदानेन तथा महद्यश उपाश्नुते॥ 53 ॥
3.69.m: And when he attains human birth, he is born with a famous name. / Likewise, by presenting a bell, he attains great fame.

3.69.s:
saubhāgyamathavāpnoti kiṅkiṇīḥ pradadanhareḥ ..
kūṭāgāraṃ tathā dattvā nagarādhipatirbhavet .. 54..
3.69.d:
सौभाग्यमथवाप्नोति किङ्किणीः प्रददन्हरेः ॥
कूटागारं तथा दत्त्वा नगराधिपतिर्भवेत् ॥ 54॥
3.69.m: Or he attains good fortune by presenting small bells to Hari. / And by giving a pavilion with a vaulted roof, he becomes the ruler of a city,

3.69.s:
kīrtyā yuktastathā loke dhārmikaścāpi jāyate ..
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi nākaloke sa modate ..55 ...
3.69.d:
कीर्त्या युक्तस्तथा लोके धार्मिकश्चापि जायते ॥
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि नाकलोके स मोदते ॥55 ॥।
3.69.m: and is born in the world endowed with fame and righteous. / He rejoices in the world of heaven for many thousands of years.

3.69.s:
patākāṃ ye prayacchanti kūṭāgāre manoharām ..
santyajya sakalaṃ pāpaṃ vāyuloke vrajanti te .. 56 ..
3.69.d:
पताकां ये प्रयच्छन्ति कूटागारे मनोहराम् ॥
सन्त्यज्य सकलं पापं वायुलोके व्रजन्ति ते ॥ 56 ॥
3.69.m: Those who offer a charming banner on a vaulted pavilion, / abandoning all evil, go to the world of Vāyu.

3.69.s:
patākāṃ ca śubhāṃ dattvā tathā keśavaveśmani ...
vāyulokamavāpnoti bahūnyabdagaṇāni tu .. 57 ..
3.69.d:
पताकां च शुभां दत्त्वा तथा केशववेश्मनि ॥।
वायुलोकमवाप्नोति बहून्यब्दगणानि तु ॥ 57 ॥
3.69.m: And by giving an auspicious banner in the temple of Keśava, / he attains the world of Vāyu for many series of years.

3.69.s:
dodhūyate yathā sā ca vāyunā keśavālaye ..
tathātathā hi sakalaṃ dehātpāpaṃ vidhūyate .. 58 ..
3.69.d:
दोधूयते यथा सा च वायुना केशवालये ॥
तथातथा हि सकलं देहात्पापं विधूयते ॥ 58 ॥
3.69.m: Just as it is shaken to and fro by the wind in the temple of Keśava, / so indeed is all evil shaken off from the body.

3.69.s:
yathāyathā ca sā śobhāṃ karoti tridaśālaye ..
tathātathā sa yaśasā mahatā bhuvi rājate .. 59 ..
3.69.d:
यथायथा च सा शोभां करोति त्रिदशालये ॥
तथातथा स यशसा महता भुवि राजते ॥ 59 ॥
3.69.m: And just as it provides beauty in the temple of the thirty [gods], / so does he shine with great fame on earth.

3.69.s:
vitānakapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ...
parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate .. 3.341.60 ..
3.69.d:
वितानकप्रदानेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥।
परां निर्वृतिमाप्नोति यत्रयत्राभिजायते ॥ 3.341.60 ॥
3.69.m: By presenting a canopy, he is freed from all sins; / he attains supreme happiness wherever he is born.

3.69.s:
dattvā tu devakarmārthaṃ navāṃ vedīṃ dṛḍhāṃ śubhām ..
pārthivatvamavāpnoti vedirhi pṛthivī yataḥ..61..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा तु देवकर्मार्थं नवां वेदीं दृढां शुभाम् ॥
पार्थिवत्वमवाप्नोति वेदिर्हि पृथिवी यतः॥61॥
3.69.m: By giving a new, firm, auspicious altar for the rites of the deity, / he attains kingship, for the altar is indeed the earth.

3.69.s:
yaḥ kumbhaṃ devakarmārthaṃ naro dadyānnavaṃ śubham ..
sa lokamāpnoti naro vāruṇaṃ gatakalmaṣaḥ .. 62 ..
3.69.d:
यः कुम्भं देवकर्मार्थं नरो दद्यान्नवं शुभम् ॥
स लोकमाप्नोति नरो वारुणं गतकल्मषः ॥ 62 ॥
3.69.m: A man who gives a new, auspicious jar for the rites of the deity, / that man, freed from taint, attains the world of Varuṇa.

3.69.s:
caturaḥ kalaśāndadyādyastu devagṛhe naraḥ ..
catussamudravalayāṃ sa ca bhuṅkte vasundharām .. 63 ..
3.69.d:
चतुरः कलशान्दद्याद्यस्तु देवगृहे नरः ॥
चतुस्समुद्रवलयां स च भुङ्क्ते वसुन्धराम् ॥ 63 ॥
3.69.m: A man who gives four water-pitchers in the temple of a deity / enjoys the earth encircled by the four oceans.

3.69.s:
dattvaikamapi viprendrāḥ kalaśaṃ susamāhitaḥ ..
rājā bhavati dharmātmā bhūtale nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 64 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वैकमपि विप्रेन्द्राः कलशं सुसमाहितः ॥
राजा भवति धर्मात्मा भूतले नात्र संशयः ॥ 64 ॥
3.69.m: Having given even a single water-pitcher, well-composed in mind, O leaders of the twice-born, / he becomes a righteous king on the surface of the earth; of this there is no doubt.

3.69.s:
vāridhānīṃ tathā dattvā vāruṇaṃ lokamaśnute ..
kamaṇḍalupradānena godānaphalamāpnuyāt ..65..
3.69.d:
वारिधानीं तथा दत्त्वा वारुणं लोकमश्नुते ॥
कमण्डलुप्रदानेन गोदानफलमाप्नुयात् ॥65॥
3.69.m: Likewise, having given a water-reservoir, he enjoys the world of Varuṇa. / By presenting a water-pot, he obtains the fruit of giving a cow.

3.69.s:
uśīrakūrcakaṃ dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
dattvā gopālakānviprāḥ sarvapāpānapohati .. 66 ..
3.69.d:
उशीरकूर्चकं दत्त्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
दत्त्वा गोपालकान्विप्राः सर्वपापानपोहति ॥ 66 ॥
3.69.m: By giving a brush of uśīra grass, one is released from all sins; / by giving cowherds, O brahmins, he removes all sins.

3.69.s:
dattvā cāmarajaṃ kūrcaṃ śriyamāpnotyanuttamām ..
āsanānāṃ pradānena sthānaṃ sarvatra vindati .. 67 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा चामरजं कूर्चं श्रियमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
आसनानां प्रदानेन स्थानं सर्वत्र विन्दति ॥ 67 ॥
3.69.m: By giving a brush made of chowrie hair, he obtains unsurpassed prosperity; / by the gift of seats, he finds a place everywhere.

3.69.s:
pādapīṭhapradānena gatimāpnotyanuttamām ..
godānaphalamāpnoti tathā pādyaprado naraḥ .. 68 ..
3.69.d:
पादपीठप्रदानेन गतिमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
गोदानफलमाप्नोति तथा पाद्यप्रदो नरः ॥ 68 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of a footstool, he attains an unsurpassed state; / likewise, a man who gives water for washing the feet obtains the fruit of the gift of a cow.

3.69.s:
lokeṣu dhvajabhūtaḥ syādviṣṇordattvā tathā dhvajam ..
śakralokānavāpnoti bahūnabdagaṇānnaraḥ .. 69 ..
3.69.d:
लोकेषु ध्वजभूतः स्याद्विष्णोर्दत्त्वा तथा ध्वजम् ॥
शक्रलोकानवाप्नोति बहूनब्दगणान्नरः ॥ 69 ॥
3.69.m: By giving a banner to Viṣṇu, he becomes like a banner among the worlds; / the man attains the worlds of Śakra for many hosts of years.

3.69.s:
narastvācamanīyasya dānādbhavati nirmalaḥ ..
mukhalepapradānena paraṃ rūpamihāpnuyāt .. 3.341.70 ..
3.69.d:
नरस्त्वाचमनीयस्य दानाद्भवति निर्मलः ॥
मुखलेपप्रदानेन परं रूपमिहाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.341.70 ॥
3.69.m: A man becomes spotless from the gift of sipping-water; / by the gift of a face ointment, he obtains supreme beauty in this world.

3.69.s:
darpaṇasya pradānena darpavānrūpavānbhavet ..
darśayitvā tathā taṃ ca subhagastvabhijāyate .. 71 ..
3.69.d:
दर्पणस्य प्रदानेन दर्पवान्रूपवान्भवेत् ॥
दर्शयित्वा तथा तं च सुभगस्त्वभिजायते ॥ 71 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of a mirror, he becomes proud and handsome; / and by showing it [to the deity], he is born charming.

3.69.s:
mātrāṃ tu paricaryārthe nivedya vidhivattathā ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute .. 72 ..
3.69.d:
मात्रां तु परिचर्यार्थे निवेद्य विधिवत्तथा ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥ 72 ॥
3.69.m: Having offered according to rule personal paraphernalia for attendance, / he enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice complete with all desires.

3.69.s:
dhānyānāmatha sasyānāṃ bījānāmatha dhārmikaḥ ..
suvarṇaraupyalohānāṃ rūpakāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ..73 ..
3.69.d:
धान्यानामथ सस्यानां बीजानामथ धार्मिकः ॥
सुवर्णरौप्यलोहानां रूपकाणां तथैव च ॥73 ॥
3.69.m: Then, of grains, of crops, of seeds, the righteous person, / and likewise of gold, silver, iron, and coins,

3.69.s:
sahasraguṇamāpnoti phalamanyatra kīrttanāt ..
rūpyado rūpamāpnoti viśeṣādbhuvi durlabham .. 74 ..
3.69.d:
सहस्रगुणमाप्नोति फलमन्यत्र कीर्त्तनात् ॥
रूप्यदो रूपमाप्नोति विशेषाद्भुवि दुर्लभम् ॥ 74 ॥
3.69.m: obtains a thousandfold fruit beyond what is declared elsewhere; / the giver of silver obtains beauty that is especially rare on earth.

3.69.s:
naraḥ suvarṇadānena sarvānkāmānupāśnute ..
naḍa dānena lokeṣu grāmaṇyamupagacchati .. 75 ..
3.69.d:
नरः सुवर्णदानेन सर्वान्कामानुपाश्नुते ॥
नड दानेन लोकेषु ग्रामण्यमुपगच्छति ॥ 75 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of gold, a man attains all desires; / by the gift of reeds, he attains headmanship among the worlds.

3.69.s:
gavāṃ lokamavāpnoti dhenuṃ dattvā payasvinīm ..
anaḍuhaḥ pradānena daśadhenuphalaṃ labhet ..76 ..
3.69.d:
गवां लोकमवाप्नोति धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम् ॥
अनडुहः प्रदानेन दशधेनुफलं लभेत् ॥76 ॥
3.69.m: Having given a milch cow, he attains the world of cows; / by the gift of a draft ox, he obtains the fruit of ten cows.

3.69.s:
ajāvimahiṣoṣṭrāṇāṃ dānamaśvatarasya ca ..
sahasraguṇitaṃ dānaṃ pūrvaṃ proktaṃ prakīrtitam .. 77 ..
3.69.d:
अजाविमहिषोष्ट्राणां दानमश्वतरस्य च ॥
सहस्रगुणितं दानं पूर्वं प्रोक्तं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 77 ॥
3.69.m: The gift of goats, sheep, buffaloes, camels, and mules, / is proclaimed to have a thousandfold the gift previously stated.

3.69.s:
āraṇyamṛgajātīnāṃ tathā dānācca pakṣiṇām ..
agniṣṭomamavāpnoti subhagaśca tathā bhavet .. 78..
3.69.d:
आरण्यमृगजातीनां तथा दानाच्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति सुभगश्च तथा भवेत् ॥ 78॥
3.69.m: And from the gift of species of wild beasts and birds, / he attains the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice and becomes charming.

3.69.s:
mṛdbhogadānāddevasya bhūmimāpnotyanuttamām ..
dantakāṣṭhapradānena tathā saubhāgyamarhati .. 79 ..
3.69.d:
मृद्भोगदानाद्देवस्य भूमिमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
दन्तकाष्ठप्रदानेन तथा सौभाग्यमर्हति ॥ 79 ॥
3.69.m: From the gift of land for the god's enjoyment, he obtains unsurpassed land; / by the gift of a tooth-stick, he likewise deserves good fortune.

3.69.s:
jihvā nirlekhanaṃ dattvā virogastvabhijāyate ..
yuktaḥ pītapatākābhirnivedya garuḍadhvajam .. 3.341.80 ..
3.69.d:
जिह्वा निर्लेखनं दत्त्वा विरोगस्त्वभिजायते ॥
युक्तः पीतपताकाभिर्निवेद्य गरुडध्वजम् ॥ 3.341.80 ॥
3.69.m: Having given a tongue-scraper, he is born free from disease. / Having offered a Garuḍa banner equipped with yellow flags

3.69.s:
keśavaṃ yo dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śakraloke mahīyate ..
yuktaṃ nīlapatākābhistālaṃ dattvā dvijottamāḥ..81..
3.69.d:
केशवं यो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शक्रलोके महीयते ॥
युक्तं नीलपताकाभिस्तालं दत्त्वा द्विजोत्तमाः॥81॥
3.69.m: to Keśava, O best of the twice-born, he is honored in the world of Śakra. / Having given a palm banner equipped with dark-blue flags, O best of the twice-born,

3.69.s:
yasmāllokātparibhraṣṭo virāgastvabhijāyate ..
yuktaṃ śvetapatākābhiragāraṃ yaḥ prayacchati..82..
3.69.d:
यस्माल्लोकात्परिभ्रष्टो विरागस्त्वभिजायते ॥
युक्तं श्वेतपताकाभिरगारं यः प्रयच्छति॥82॥
3.69.m: [and] falling from whatever world, he is born free from passion. / He who gives a dwelling equipped with white flags

3.69.s:
rājā bhavati lokesminbhuktvā lokānpracetasaḥ ..
yuktaṃ raktapatākābhirdatvā ṛṣyamanuttamam .. 83 ..
3.69.d:
राजा भवति लोकेस्मिन्भुक्त्वा लोकान्प्रचेतसः ॥
युक्तं रक्तपताकाभिर्दत्वा ऋष्यमनुत्तमम् ॥ 83 ॥
3.69.m: becomes a king in this world after enjoying the worlds of Varuṇa. / Having given an unsurpassed ṛṣya [banner] equipped with red flags,

3.69.s:
alakāṃ samavāpnoti tathā pāpakṣayaṃ naraḥ ..
toraṇaṃ kārayedyastu devadevālaye naraḥ .. 84 ..
3.69.d:
अलकां समवाप्नोति तथा पापक्षयं नरः ॥
तोरणं कारयेद्यस्तु देवदेवालये नरः ॥ 84 ॥
3.69.m: a man attains Alakā and the destruction of sin. / The man who causes an archway to be made at the temple of the God of gods,

3.69.s:
lokeṣu tasya dvārāṇi bhavanti vivṛtāni tu ..
śayanāsanadānena sthitiṃ vindati śāśvatīm ..89..
3.69.d:
लोकेषु तस्य द्वाराणि भवन्ति विवृतानि तु ॥
शयनासनदानेन स्थितिं विन्दति शाश्वतीम् ॥89॥
3.69.m: the doors [of success] among the worlds become open for him. / By the gift of beds and seats, he finds an eternal standing.

3.69.s:
uttaracchadadānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
devaveśmopabhogāni śilpabhāṇḍāni yo naraḥ .. 86 ..
3.69.d:
उत्तरच्छददानेन सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
देववेश्मोपभोगानि शिल्पभाण्डानि यो नरः ॥ 86 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of an upper covering, he obtains all desires. / That man who [gives] craft implements for the use of the temple of the god,

3.69.s:
dadyādvā vādyabhāṇḍāni gaṇeśatvamavāpnuyāt ..
devaśriteṣu yatkiñciddadyādbhaktisamanvitaḥ .. 87 ..
3.69.d:
दद्याद्वा वाद्यभाण्डानि गणेशत्वमवाप्नुयात् ॥
देवश्रितेषु यत्किञ्चिद्दद्याद्भक्तिसमन्वितः ॥ 87 ॥
3.69.m: or who gives musical instruments, attains the status of a lord of the gaṇas. / Whatever one gives endowed with devotion to those sheltered by the god,

3.69.s:
tadevākṣayamāpnoti devadevaprasādataḥ ..
dattvā dhānyāni bījāni sasyāni vividhāni ca ..88..
3.69.d:
तदेवाक्षयमाप्नोति देवदेवप्रसादतः ॥
दत्त्वा धान्यानि बीजानि सस्यानि विविधानि च ॥88॥
3.69.m: that very thing becomes imperishable through the grace of the God of gods. / Having given grains, seeds, and various crops,

3.69.s:
rūpakāṇi ca tānyeva prāpnotyayutaśaḥ punaḥ ..
dattvā śākāni rasyāṇi viśokastvabhijāyate .. 89 ..
3.69.d:
रूपकाणि च तान्येव प्राप्नोत्ययुतशः पुनः ॥
दत्त्वा शाकानि रस्याणि विशोकस्त्वभिजायते ॥ 89 ॥
3.69.m: and coins, he obtains those very things by the tens of thousands again; / having given savoury vegetables, he is born free from sorrow.

3.69.s:
dattvā ca vyaṃjanārthāya tathopakaraṇāni ca ..
puṣpavṛkṣaṃ tato dattvā grāmasyādhipatirbhavet..3.341.90..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा च व्यंजनार्थाय तथोपकरणानि च ॥
पुष्पवृक्षं ततो दत्त्वा ग्रामस्याधिपतिर्भवेत्॥3.341.90॥
3.69.m: And having given side-dishes and also implements, / and then giving a flowering tree, he becomes the lord of a village.

3.69.s:
phalavṛkṣaṃ tathā dattvā nagarādhipatirbhavet..
ārāmaṃ kārayitvā tu rājā vai pārthivo bhaveta..91..
3.69.d:
फलवृक्षं तथा दत्त्वा नगराधिपतिर्भवेत्॥
आरामं कारयित्वा तु राजा वै पार्थिवो भवेत॥91॥
3.69.m: Likewise, having given a fruit tree, he becomes the lord of a city; / and having caused a grove to be made, he becomes an earthly king.

3.69.s:
jalāśayaṃ tathā kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
sapuṣpaissaphalairvṛkṣairyuktaṃ kṛtvā jalāśayaiḥ .. 92 ..
3.69.d:
जलाशयं तथा कृत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
सपुष्पैस्सफलैर्वृक्षैर्युक्तं कृत्वा जलाशयैः ॥ 92 ॥
3.69.m: Likewise, having made a reservoir of water, he is released from all sins; / having made [a temple complex] equipped with trees bearing flowers and fruits, with reservoirs of water,

3.69.s:
udyānaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍairaiśvaryaiśca manoharaiḥ ..
śvetadvīpamavāpnoti bahūnyabdagaṇāni tu .. 93 ..
3.69.d:
उद्यानैः पद्मिनीखण्डैरैश्वर्यैश्च मनोहरैः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपमवाप्नोति बहून्यब्दगणानि तु ॥ 93 ॥
3.69.m: with parks, lotus ponds, and charming splendors, / he attains Śvetadvīpa for many hosts of years.

3.69.s:
prīṇayeddevadeveśaṃ gavāṃ grāmeṇa yo naraḥ ..
tasya prītaḥ sa bhagavānabhīṣṭaphalado bhavet .. 94 ..
3.69.d:
प्रीणयेद्देवदेवेशं गवां ग्रामेण यो नरः ॥
तस्य प्रीतः स भगवानभीष्टफलदो भवेत् ॥ 94 ॥
3.69.m: The man who pleases the Lord of the God of gods with a herd of cows, / pleased with him, the Blessed One becomes the granter of his desired fruit.

3.69.s:
atīva dayitāstasya brāhmaṇā dvijasattamāḥ ..
brahmaṇaiḥ pūjatairviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ bhavati pūjitaḥ .. 95 ..
3.69.d:
अतीव दयितास्तस्य ब्राह्मणा द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
ब्रह्मणैः पूजतैर्विष्णुः स्वयं भवति पूजितः ॥ 95 ॥
3.69.m: Extremely dear to him are brahmins, O best of the twice-born; / when brahmins are honored, Viṣṇu himself is honored.

3.69.s:
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānātha bahūnāmapi dānataḥ ..
yaḥ prīṇāti jagannāthaṃ tasya devaḥ prasīdati .. 96..
3.69.d:
दीनांधकृपणानाथ बहूनामपि दानतः ॥
यः प्रीणाति जगन्नाथं तस्य देवः प्रसीदति ॥ 96॥
3.69.m: By the gift even to many poor, blind, wretched, and helpless people, / he who pleases the Lord of the World—with him the god is pleased.

3.69.s:
upavāsavrataiḥ snānaistīrthānusaraṇena ca..
āyatasthānasaṃsthānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca vivarjanāt .. 97..
3.69.d:
उपवासव्रतैः स्नानैस्तीर्थानुसरणेन च॥
आयतस्थानसंस्थानां पशूनां च विवर्जनात् ॥ 97॥
3.69.m: Through fasting vows, baths, and resorting to holy places, / and through abandoning the animals kept in widespread places,

3.69.s:
guruśuśrūṣayā kṣāntyā tathā vai śrāddhakarmaṇā ..
āhāraniyamaistaistaiḥ parāpīḍairviśeṣataḥ .. 98 ..
3.69.d:
गुरुशुश्रूषया क्षान्त्या तथा वै श्राद्धकर्मणा ॥
आहारनियमैस्तैस्तैः परापीडैर्विशेषतः ॥ 98 ॥
3.69.m: through service to the teacher, forbearance, and likewise through the rite of ancestral offerings, / through various dietary restrictions, especially without tormenting others,

3.69.s:
pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ śvetadvīpamavāpnuyāt ..
paraṃ padamavāpnoti prasanne madhusūdane .. 99 ..
3.69.d:
पूजयित्वा जगन्नाथं श्वेतद्वीपमवाप्नुयात् ॥
परं पदमवाप्नोति प्रसन्ने मधुसूदने ॥ 99 ॥
3.69.m: having worshiped the Lord of the World, he reaches Śvetadvīpa; / when Madhusūdana is pleased, he attains the supreme state.

3.69.s:
abhivādya jagannāthaṃ kṛtārthaśca tathā bhavet ..
namaskārakriyā tasya sarvapāpapraṇāśinī .. 3.341.100 ..
3.69.d:
अभिवाद्य जगन्नाथं कृतार्थश्च तथा भवेत् ॥
नमस्कारक्रिया तस्य सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ॥ 3.341.100 ॥
3.69.m: Having bowed to the Lord of the World, he becomes one who has achieved his goal; / the act of paying homage to him destroys all sins.

3.69.s:
praṇāmaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ tathaiva parikīrtitam ..
jānubhyāṃ caiva pāṇibhyāṃ śirasā ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ..101..
3.69.d:
प्रणामं पापशमनं तथैव परिकीर्तितम् ॥
जानुभ्यां चैव पाणिभ्यां शिरसा च विचक्षणः ॥101॥
3.69.m: Prostration is likewise proclaimed as an extinguisher of sins. / The wise man, with both knees, both hands, and his head,

3.69.s:
kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ devebhyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
paramāṇūni vartante lalāṭe puruṣasya ca .. 102 ..
3.69.d:
कृत्वा प्रणामं देवेभ्यः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
परमाणूनि वर्तन्ते ललाटे पुरुषस्य च ॥ 102 ॥
3.69.m: having made prostration to the gods, obtains all desires. / As many earthly atoms are present on the forehead of a man

3.69.s:
pārthivāni bhavaṃtīha namato madhusūdanam ..
tāvantyabdāni viprendrāḥ svargaloke mahīyate..103..
3.69.d:
पार्थिवानि भवंतीह नमतो मधुसूदनम् ॥
तावन्त्यब्दानि विप्रेन्द्राः स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥103॥
3.69.m: who bows here to Madhusūdana, / for that many years, O best of brahmins, is he honored in the world of heaven.

3.69.s:
devārcādarśanādeva praṇamenmadhusūdanam ..
sthānāpekṣā na kartavyā dṛṣṭvārcāṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 104 ..
3.69.d:
देवार्चादर्शनादेव प्रणमेन्मधुसूदनम् ॥
स्थानापेक्षा न कर्तव्या दृष्ट्वार्चां द्विजसत्तमाः ॥ 104 ॥
3.69.m: One should bow to Madhusūdana immediately upon the sight of the image of the god; / upon seeing the image, O best of the twice-born, no regard should be had for the place.

3.69.s:
devārcādṛṣṭipūtaṃ hi śuciḥ sarvaṃ prakīrtitam ..
devārcādṛṣṭipūtena snānaṃ kṛtvā jalāśaye .. 105..
3.69.d:
देवार्चादृष्टिपूतं हि शुचिः सर्वं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
देवार्चादृष्टिपूतेन स्नानं कृत्वा जलाशये ॥ 105॥
3.69.m: For everything purified by the gaze of the god's image is declared to be clean; / having bathed in a reservoir of water purified by the gaze of the god's image,

3.69.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kṣaṇādbhavati nirmalaḥ ..
tīrthānāṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ sannidhānaṃ prakīrtitam..106..
3.69.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः क्षणाद्भवति निर्मलः ॥
तीर्थानां तत्र सर्वेषां सन्निधानं प्रकीर्तितम्॥106॥
3.69.m: released from all sins, he becomes spotless in an instant; / the presence of all holy waters is declared to be there.

3.69.s:
pādodakena vābhyukṣya tathā mūrddhānamātmanaḥ ..
snāto bhavati dharmātmā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..107..
3.69.d:
पादोदकेन वाभ्युक्ष्य तथा मूर्द्धानमात्मनः ॥
स्नातो भवति धर्मात्मा नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥107॥
3.69.m: Or having sprinkled his own head with the water of the [god's] feet, / the righteous person becomes [as if] bathed; no hesitation should be made here.

3.69.s:
pādodakaṃ śāntikaramamaṅgalyavināśanam ..
duṣṭaduḥsvapnaśamanaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam ..108..
3.69.d:
पादोदकं शान्तिकरममङ्गल्यविनाशनम् ॥
दुष्टदुःस्वप्नशमनं सर्वपापविनाशनम् ॥108॥
3.69.m: The water of the feet brings peace and destroys inauspiciousness; / it quells bad and evil dreams and destroys all sins.

3.69.s:
dhanyaṃ pavitraṃ maṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam ..
śirasā mānavaśreṣṭhāḥ kālyapuṇyāya dhārayet..109..
3.69.d:
धन्यं पवित्रं मङ्गल्यं सर्वपापहरं शिवम् ॥
शिरसा मानवश्रेष्ठाः काल्यपुण्याय धारयेत्॥109॥
3.69.m: Auspicious, purifying, conferring blessings, removing all sins, and benevolent, / one should hold it upon the head for morning merit, O best of men.

3.69.s:
sarvā ṅgapraṇipātena sarvakāmayutāṃ naraḥ ..
sarvānarthavinirmukto godānaphalamāpnuyāt .. 3.341.110 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वा ङ्गप्रणिपातेन सर्वकामयुतां नरः ॥
सर्वानर्थविनिर्मुक्तो गोदानफलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.341.110 ॥
3.69.m: Through prostration with all limbs, a man endowed with all desires, / freed from all misfortunes, obtains the fruit of the gift of a cow.

3.69.s:
rukmamāṣakadānasya phalaṃ viprāḥ padepade ..
puruṣastu samāpnoti yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām .. 111 ..
3.69.d:
रुक्ममाषकदानस्य फलं विप्राः पदेपदे ॥
पुरुषस्तु समाप्नोति यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥ 111 ॥
3.69.m:
At every step, O brahmins, a man who circumambulates
obtains the fruit of the gift of a māṣaka of gold.

3.69.s:
dhyānaṃ tu devadevasya sarvabādhāvināśanam ..
yāvatkālaṃ karotīha dhyānaṃ vai niścalaṃ naraḥ .. 112 ..
3.69.d:
ध्यानं तु देवदेवस्य सर्वबाधाविनाशनम् ॥
यावत्कालं करोतीह ध्यानं वै निश्चलं नरः ॥ 112 ॥
3.69.m:
Meditation upon the God of gods destroys all afflictions.
For whatever length of time a man here performs steadfast meditation,

3.69.s:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
nirāśīrnirmamo yastu viṣṇordhyānarato bhavet .. 113 ..
3.69.d:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
निराशीर्निर्ममो यस्तु विष्णोर्ध्यानरतो भवेत् ॥ 113 ॥
3.69.m:
for so many thousands of years he is honored in the heavenly world.
He who, free from expectation and without sense of mineness, delights in meditation on Viṣṇu,

3.69.s:
tatpadaṃ samavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati ..
yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva dhyānameva paraṃ smṛtam ..114..
3.69.d:
तत्पदं समवाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति ॥
यज्ञानां तपसां चैव ध्यानमेव परं स्मृतम् ॥114॥
3.69.m:
attains that state having gone to which one does not grieve.
Meditation alone is traditionally held to be superior to sacrifices and austerities.

3.69.s:
devāgre kārayedyastu ramyāmāpaṇavīthikām..
rājā bhavati lokeṣu vijitārirmahāyaśāḥ..115..
3.69.d:
देवाग्रे कारयेद्यस्तु रम्यामापणवीथिकाम्॥
राजा भवति लोकेषु विजितारिर्महायशाः॥115॥
3.69.m:
He who causes a delightful market street to be made before the deity
becomes a king in these worlds, his enemies conquered, possessing great renown.

3.69.s:
nagaraṃ ca tathā kṛtvā sāmrājyamadhigacchati ..
yānavāhanadānena sarvakālaṃ sukhī bhavet ..116..
3.69.d:
नगरं च तथा कृत्वा साम्राज्यमधिगच्छति ॥
यानवाहनदानेन सर्वकालं सुखी भवेत् ॥116॥
3.69.m:
And by establishing a city in that way, he attains universal sovereignty.
By the gift of a vehicle or conveyance, he shall be happy for all time.

3.69.s:
śibikāṃ ye prayacchaṃti te prayāntyamarāvatīm ..
aśvasthāḥ sūryalokasthā rājante divi sūryavat ..117..
3.69.d:
शिबिकां ये प्रयच्छंति ते प्रयान्त्यमरावतीम् ॥
अश्वस्थाः सूर्यलोकस्था राजन्ते दिवि सूर्यवत् ॥117॥
3.69.m:
Those who give a palanquin go to Amarāvatī.
Mounted on horses, abiding in the solar world, they shine in heaven like the sun.

3.69.s:
karīndradānācchakrasya cirāllokāccyuto naraḥ ..
rājā bhavati dharmātmā pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivī patiḥ .. 118 ..
3.69.d:
करीन्द्रदानाच्छक्रस्य चिराल्लोकाच्च्युतो नरः ॥
राजा भवति धर्मात्मा पृथिव्यां पृथिवी पतिः ॥ 118 ॥
3.69.m:
From the gift of a lord of elephants, a man, fallen after a long time from the realm of Śakra,
becomes a righteous king, an earth-protecting lord upon the earth.

3.69.s:
dāsaṃ dattvā sukhī loke svargabhraṣṭobhijāyate ..
dāsīṃ dattvā tathā viprā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 119 ..
3.69.d:
दासं दत्त्वा सुखी लोके स्वर्गभ्रष्टोभिजायते ॥
दासीं दत्त्वा तथा विप्रा नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 119 ॥
3.69.m:
Having given a male servant, he is born happy in the world when fallen from heaven;
likewise, O brahmins, having given a female servant—there is no doubt on this point.

3.69.s:
gaṇikāṃ ye prayacchaṃti nṛtyagītaviśāradām ..
sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktāste prayāntyamarāvatīm .. 3.341.120 ..
3.69.d:
गणिकां ये प्रयच्छंति नृत्यगीतविशारदाम् ॥
सर्वदुःखविनिर्मुक्तास्ते प्रयान्त्यमरावतीम् ॥ 3.341.120 ॥
3.69.m:
Those who offer a courtesan skilled in dance and song,
freed from all sorrow, go to Amarāvatī.

3.69.s:
dundubhiṃ ye prayacchanti kīrtimanto bhavanti te ..
rājā bhavati lokesmiñchatraṃ dattvā dvijottamāḥ .. 121 ..
3.69.d:
दुन्दुभिं ये प्रयच्छन्ति कीर्तिमन्तो भवन्ति ते ॥
राजा भवति लोकेस्मिञ्छत्रं दत्त्वा द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 121 ॥
3.69.m:
Those who provide a kettledrum become famous.
By giving an umbrella, O foremost of the twice-born, one becomes a king in this world.

3.69.s:
nāpnoti ripujaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃgrāme ripujidbhavet ..
tālavṛntapradānena nirvṛtiṃ prāpnuyātparām .. 122 ..
3.69.d:
नाप्नोति रिपुजं दुःखं संग्रामे रिपुजिद्भवेत् ॥
तालवृन्तप्रदानेन निर्वृतिं प्राप्नुयात्पराम् ॥ 122 ॥
3.69.m:
He incurs no suffering caused by foes; in battle he conquers enemies.
By the gift of a palm-leaf fan, one attains supreme contentment.

3.69.s:
tathācamanadānena śrīmānbhavati bhūtale ..
mucyate ca tathā pāpaiḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 123 ..
3.69.d:
तथाचमनदानेन श्रीमान्भवति भूतले ॥
मुच्यते च तथा पापैः स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 123 ॥
3.69.m:
Likewise, by the gift of sipping water, he becomes prosperous upon the earth;
and likewise he is freed from sins and goes to the heavenly world.

3.69.s:
upānatsaṃpradānena vimānamadhigacchati ..
yatheṣṭaṃ tena lokeṣu vicaratyamaraprabhaḥ .. 124 ..
3.69.d:
उपानत्संप्रदानेन विमानमधिगच्छति ॥
यथेष्टं तेन लोकेषु विचरत्यमरप्रभः ॥ 124 ॥
3.69.m:
By the gift of sandals, he obtains a celestial chariot;
by means of it he roams as he pleases through the worlds, radiant as an immortal.

3.69.s:
yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ rājaliṅgaṃ surālaye ..
dattvā bhavati rājaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. .. 125 ..
3.69.d:
यथादेशं यथाकालं राजलिङ्गं सुरालये ॥
दत्त्वा भवति राजैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ ॥ 125 ॥
3.69.m:
By giving royal insignia in the temple of a deity according to place and according to time,
one indeed becomes a king; on this point no doubt should be entertained.

3.69.s:
dhāraṇīyopayogyāni dattvātyantaṃ sukhī bhavet ..
mālyādhāraṃ tathā dattvā dhūpādhāraṃ tathaiva ca .. 126 ..
3.69.d:
धारणीयोपयोग्यानि दत्त्वात्यन्तं सुखी भवेत् ॥
माल्याधारं तथा दत्त्वा धूपाधारं तथैव च ॥ 126 ॥
3.69.m:
By giving things suitable to wear, one becomes exceedingly happy.
Likewise, by giving a stand for garlands, and in the same way an incense burner,

3.69.s:
gandhādhāraṃ tathā pātraṃ kāmānāṃ pātratāṃ vrajet ..
samudrajāni pātrāṇi dattvā vai taijasāni vā .. 127 ..
3.69.d:
गन्धाधारं तथा पात्रं कामानां पात्रतां व्रजेत् ॥
समुद्रजानि पात्राणि दत्त्वा वै तैजसानि वा ॥ 127 ॥
3.69.m:
and a receptacle for fragrant pastes, one becomes a worthy vessel for one's desires.
By giving vessels produced from the ocean or made of metal,

3.69.s:
pātraṃ bhavati kāmānāṃ vidyānāṃ ca dhanasya ca ..
yatkiñciddevadevāya dadyādbhaktisamanvitaḥ .. 128 ..
3.69.d:
पात्रं भवति कामानां विद्यानां च धनस्य च ॥
यत्किञ्चिद्देवदेवाय दद्याद्भक्तिसमन्वितः ॥ 128 ॥
3.69.m:
one becomes a receptacle for desires, sciences, and wealth.
Whatever a person gives to the God of gods with devotion,

3.69.s:
tadevākṣayyamāpnoti svarlokaṃ ca gacchati ..
vismāpanīyaṃ yatkiñcitkṛtvātyantaṃ sukhī bhavet .. 129 ..
3.69.d:
तदेवाक्षय्यमाप्नोति स्वर्लोकं च गच्छति ॥
विस्मापनीयं यत्किञ्चित्कृत्वात्यन्तं सुखी भवेत् ॥ 129 ॥
3.69.m:
that very thing he receives inexhaustibly, and he goes to the world of heaven.
Having done anything that causes wonder, one becomes exceedingly happy.

3.69.s:
snānaśāṭakadānena vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ..
tailena snapanaṃ kṛtvā saubhāgyamadhigacchati .. 3.341.130 ..
3.69.d:
स्नानशाटकदानेन वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥
तैलेन स्नपनं कृत्वा सौभाग्यमधिगच्छति ॥ 3.341.130 ॥
3.69.m:
By the gift of a bathing garment, one obtains the fruit of an agniṣṭoma sacrifice.
By performing a bath with oil, one obtains good fortune.

3.69.s:
gaṃdhatailāni divyāni sugandhīni śucīni ca ..
keśavāya naro dattvā gandharvaiḥ saha modate .. 131 ..
3.69.d:
गंधतैलानि दिव्यानि सुगन्धीनि शुचीनि च ॥
केशवाय नरो दत्त्वा गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते ॥ 131 ॥
3.69.m:
A man who gives to Keśava divine fragrant oils, sweet-smelling and pure,
rejoices together with the gandharvas.

3.69.s:
ghṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpānvyapohati ..
ghṛtaprasthena deveśaṃ pauṣapuṣyamitetaraḥ .. 132 ..
3.69.d:
घृतेन स्नपनं कृत्वा सर्वपापान्व्यपोहति ॥
घृतप्रस्थेन देवेशं पौषपुष्यमितेतरः ॥ 132 ॥
3.69.m:
By bathing [the Lord] with ghee, he removes all sins.
A man, when the moon is in Pauṣa-Puṣya, having bathed the Lord of gods

3.69.s:
snāpayitvāśvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
etadeva phalaṃ proktamuttarāyaṇavāsare .. 133 ..
3.69.d:
स्नापयित्वाश्वमेधस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
एतदेव फलं प्रोक्तमुत्तरायणवासरे ॥ 133 ॥
3.69.m:
with a prastha of ghee, attains without doubt the fruit of a horse sacrifice.
This very fruit is declared on the day of the northern solstice.

3.69.s:
ghṛtaṃ pavitramatulaṃ ghṛtamannamanuttamam ..
tena gavyena saṃsnāpya pratimāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ naraḥ .. 134 ..
3.69.d:
घृतं पवित्रमतुलं घृतमन्नमनुत्तमम् ॥
तेन गव्येन संस्नाप्य प्रतिमां वैष्णवीं नरः ॥ 134 ॥
3.69.m:
Ghee is peerless purification; ghee is unsurpassable food.
A man, having bathed the Vaiṣṇava image with that bovine product,

3.69.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
gavāṃ lokamavāpnoti kṣīrodamatha vā punaḥ .. 135 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
गवां लोकमवाप्नोति क्षीरोदमथ वा पुनः ॥ 135 ॥
3.69.m:
enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice abounding in all desires;
he attains the world of the cows, or else the Ocean of Milk.

3.69.s:
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt ..
bhayānmucyeta bhītaśca ghṛtena snapayeddharim .. 136 ..
3.69.d:
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ॥
भयान्मुच्येत भीतश्च घृतेन स्नपयेद्धरिम् ॥ 136 ॥
3.69.m:
Afflicted with disease, he is freed from disease; bound, he is freed from bondage;
and frightened, he is freed from fear—one should bathe Hari with ghee.

3.69.s:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sarvānarthavivarjitaḥ ..
madhunā snāpanaṃ kṛtvā saubhāgyamadhigacchati .. 137 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति सर्वानर्थविवर्जितः ॥
मधुना स्नापनं कृत्वा सौभाग्यमधिगच्छति ॥ 137 ॥
3.69.m:
Deprived of all misfortunes, he attains all desires.
Having performed a bath with honey, one attains good fortune.

3.69.s:
loke mitrāṇyavāpnoti naraścekṣurasena ca ..
dugdhena snapanaṃ jñeyamamaṃgalyavināśanam .. 138 ..
3.69.d:
लोके मित्राण्यवाप्नोति नरश्चेक्षुरसेन च ॥
दुग्धेन स्नपनं ज्ञेयममंगल्यविनाशनम् ॥ 138 ॥
3.69.m:
And with sugarcane juice, a man gains friends in the world.
Bathing with milk should be known as the destroyer of inauspiciousness.

3.69.s:
kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ viprāḥ kṣīrāmbhodhipradaṃ tathā ..
deyāni deve vādyāni dadhikṣīraghṛtānyatha ..139..
3.69.d:
क्षीरेण स्नपनं विप्राः क्षीराम्भोधिप्रदं तथा ॥
देयानि देवे वाद्यानि दधिक्षीरघृतान्यथ ॥139॥
3.69.m:
Bathing with milk, O brahmins, likewise bestows the Ocean of Milk.
Musical instruments, curd, milk, and then ghee are to be offered to the deity.

3.69.s:
godhūmayavacūrṇaistu tatotsārya janārdanam ..
rodhavarṇakasaṃkīrṇairvaraṃ rūpaṃ tathāpnuyāt .. 3.341.140 ..
3.69.d:
गोधूमयवचूर्णैस्तु ततोत्सार्य जनार्दनम् ॥
रोधवर्णकसंकीर्णैर्वरं रूपं तथाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.341.140 ॥
3.69.m:
Then, having rubbed Janārdana with powders of wheat and barley
mixed with rodhra cosmetic paste, one attains excellent beauty.

3.69.s:
snapanaṃ māṣacūrṇena vahniṣṭomaphalapradam ..
masūracūrṇa dānaṃ ca tathā saubhāgyavardhanam .. 141 ..
3.69.d:
स्नपनं माषचूर्णेन वह्निष्टोमफलप्रदम् ॥
मसूरचूर्ण दानं च तथा सौभाग्यवर्धनम् ॥ 141 ॥
3.69.m:
Bathing with māṣa powder bestows the fruit of an agniṣṭoma sacrifice,
and the gift of masūra powder likewise increases good fortune.

3.69.s:
masūramāṣacūrṇaṃ tu kuṃkumakṣodasaṃyutam ..
nivedya devadevāya gandharvaiḥ saha modate .. 142 ..
3.69.d:
मसूरमाषचूर्णं तु कुंकुमक्षोदसंयुतम् ॥
निवेद्य देवदेवाय गन्धर्वैः सह मोदते ॥ 142 ॥
3.69.m:
Having offered to the God of gods powder of masūra and māṣa
combined with saffron powder, one rejoices with the gandharvas.

3.69.s:
tadā kalaśadānena priyāmāpnotyanuttamām ..
rodhrasnānapradānena varṇaṃ śubhamavāpnuyāta .. 143 ..
3.69.d:
तदा कलशदानेन प्रियामाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
रोध्रस्नानप्रदानेन वर्णं शुभमवाप्नुयात ॥ 143 ॥
3.69.m:
Then by the gift of a pitcher, he wins an unsurpassed beloved.
By offering a bath of rodhra, one attains a beautiful complexion.

3.69.s:
kālīyakapradānena parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuyāt ..
dopūrakapradānena sarvānrogānvyapohati .. 144 ..
3.69.d:
कालीयकप्रदानेन परां निर्वृतिमाप्नुयात् ॥
दोपूरकप्रदानेन सर्वान्रोगान्व्यपोहति ॥ 144 ॥
3.69.m:
By giving kālīyaka sandalwood, one attains supreme bliss.
By giving dopūraka, one dispels all diseases.

3.69.s:
tathā varṇakadānena sarvameva śubhaṃ vadeta ..
tagarasnānadānena saubhāgyamadhigacchati .. 145 ..
3.69.d:
तथा वर्णकदानेन सर्वमेव शुभं वदेत ॥
तगरस्नानदानेन सौभाग्यमधिगच्छति ॥ 145 ॥
3.69.m:
Likewise, by the gift of cosmetic paste, one is said to obtain all that is auspicious.
By giving a bath of tagara, one attains good fortune.

3.69.s:
priyatvamāpnuyālloke priyaṅgusnānado naraḥ ..
sadā bhavati siddhārthaḥ siddhārthasnānadastathā .. 146 ..
3.69.d:
प्रियत्वमाप्नुयाल्लोके प्रियङ्गुस्नानदो नरः ॥
सदा भवति सिद्धार्थः सिद्धार्थस्नानदस्तथा ॥ 146 ॥
3.69.m:
A man who gives a bath of priyaṅgu attains popularity in the world.
And he who gives a bath of white mustard always has his desires fulfilled.

3.69.s:
sarvauṣadhipradānena vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
snānārthaṃ devadevasya yastu gandhānprayacchati .. 147 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वौषधिप्रदानेन वाजिमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
स्नानार्थं देवदेवस्य यस्तु गन्धान्प्रयच्छति ॥ 147 ॥
3.69.m:
By giving all herbs, one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.
He who gives fragrances for the bath of the God of gods—

3.69.s:
bhavanti vaśagāstasya nāryaḥ sarvatra sarvadā ..
dattvā jātīphalaṃ mukhyaṃ sakalaṃ vindate śriyam .. 148 ..
3.69.d:
भवन्ति वशगास्तस्य नार्यः सर्वत्र सर्वदा ॥
दत्त्वा जातीफलं मुख्यं सकलं विन्दते श्रियम् ॥ 148 ॥
3.69.m:
women become obedient to him everywhere and always.
Having given the best nutmeg, he acquires all prosperity.

3.69.s:
śamīpatrapradānena saubhāgyamadhigacchati ..
tvakpradānāttathā loke bhavatīha balānvitaḥ .. 149 ..
3.69.d:
शमीपत्रप्रदानेन सौभाग्यमधिगच्छति ॥
त्वक्प्रदानात्तथा लोके भवतीह बलान्वितः ॥ 149 ॥
3.69.m:
By the gift of a leaf of the śamī tree, one attains good fortune.
Likewise, by the gift of cinnamon bark, one becomes endowed with strength here in the world.

3.69.s:
dattvā mṛgamadasnānaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
ratnodakapradānena śriyamāpnotyanuttamām .. 3.341.150 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा मृगमदस्नानं सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
रत्नोदकप्रदानेन श्रियमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥ 3.341.150 ॥
3.69.m:
Having given a musk bath, one attains all desires.
By the gift of gem-infused water, one attains unsurpassed prosperity.

3.69.s:
bījodakapradānena kriyāsāphalyamāpnuyāta ..
puṣpatoyapradānena śrīmānbhavati mānavaḥ .. .. 151 ..
3.69.d:
बीजोदकप्रदानेन क्रियासाफल्यमाप्नुयात ॥
पुष्पतोयप्रदानेन श्रीमान्भवति मानवः ॥ ॥ 151 ॥
3.69.m:
By the gift of seed-infused water, one attains success in one's rituals.
By the gift of flower-infused water, a man becomes prosperous.

3.69.s:
phalatoyapradānena saphalāṃ vindate kriyām ..
punnāmavāribhiryuktaṃ kalaśaṃ pūjitaṃ naraiḥ .. 152 ..
3.69.d:
फलतोयप्रदानेन सफलां विन्दते क्रियाम् ॥
पुन्नामवारिभिर्युक्तं कलशं पूजितं नरैः ॥ 152 ॥
3.69.m:
By the gift of fruit-infused water, he finds his ritual fruitful.
A jar filled with punnāga-scented water and worshiped by men,

3.69.s:
sopavāso harerdattvā putramāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
kṣīrapallavasaṃyuktānkalaśānsuvibhūṣitān .. 153 ..
3.69.d:
सोपवासो हरेर्दत्त्वा पुत्रमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
क्षीरपल्लवसंयुक्तान्कलशान्सुविभूषितान् ॥ 153 ॥
3.69.m:
if given to Hari while fasting, brings a son without doubt.
Having offered to the God of gods jars well adorned,

3.69.s:
dattvaiva devadevāya vājapeyamavāpnuyāt ..
jayakāraṃ naro yastu karoti dvijapuṅgavāḥ .. ..54 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वैव देवदेवाय वाजपेयमवाप्नुयात् ॥
जयकारं नरो यस्तु करोति द्विजपुङ्गवाः ॥ ॥54 ॥
3.69.m:
furnished with milky sprouts, one indeed obtains [the fruit of] a vājapeya sacrifice.
And that man, O bull-like twice-born, who raises cries of victory,

3.69.s:
bandināṃ sa bhavatyeva sadā stavyo narottamāḥ ..
tīrthodakāni puṇyāni svayamānīya mānavaḥ .. 155 ..
3.69.d:
बन्दिनां स भवत्येव सदा स्तव्यो नरोत्तमाः ॥
तीर्थोदकानि पुण्यानि स्वयमानीय मानवः ॥ 155 ॥
3.69.m: he becomes one ever to be praised by bards, O best of men. / A man who brings holy waters from sacred fords himself,

3.69.s:
devasya snapanaṃ dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
arcitānkalaśānkṛtvā paribhrāmya tathaiva ca .. 156 ..
3.69.d:
देवस्य स्नपनं दत्त्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
अर्चितान्कलशान्कृत्वा परिभ्राम्य तथैव च ॥ 156 ॥
3.69.m: and gives a bath to the god, is freed from all sins. / Having worshiped the water-pots, and likewise moved them around,

3.69.s:
yastyajetsalilaṃ tatra tasya puṣṭiḥ sadā bhavet ..
tīrthatoyaṃ tathā dattvā devasyācamanaṃ punaḥ .. 157 ..
3.69.d:
यस्त्यजेत्सलिलं तत्र तस्य पुष्टिः सदा भवेत् ॥
तीर्थतोयं तथा दत्त्वा देवस्याचमनं पुनः ॥ 157 ॥
3.69.m: whoever pours the water there, for him there will always be prosperity. / Likewise, having offered water from a sacred ford for the god's rinsing of the mouth,

3.69.s:
svargalokamavāpnoti sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ ..
utsādanamathābhyaṅgaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ hareḥ .. 158 ..
3.69.d:
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति सर्वपापविवर्जितः ॥
उत्सादनमथाभ्यङ्गं स्नानं कृत्वा स्वयं हरेः ॥ 158 ॥
3.69.m: he attains the world of heaven, freed from all sins. / Then, by personally performing the rubbing, anointing, and bathing of Hari,

3.69.s:
gāṇapatyamavāpnoti tathā loke sukhī bhavet ..
niṣpuṃsanārthe devasya yastu vastraṃ prayacchati .. 159 ..
3.69.d:
गाणपत्यमवाप्नोति तथा लोके सुखी भवेत् ॥
निष्पुंसनार्थे देवस्य यस्तु वस्त्रं प्रयच्छति ॥ 159 ॥
3.69.m: he attains the rank of a lord of the gaṇas, and becomes happy in this world. / Whoever offers a cloth for the drying of the god's body,

3.69.s:
candralokamavāpnoti sukhaṃ prāpnoti cottamam ..
candanenānulipyainaṃ candralokamavāpnuyāt .. 3.341.160 ..
3.69.d:
चन्द्रलोकमवाप्नोति सुखं प्राप्नोति चोत्तमम् ॥
चन्दनेनानुलिप्यैनं चन्द्रलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.341.160 ॥
3.69.m: attains the world of the Moon and reaches the highest bliss. / By anointing him with sandalwood paste, he attains the world of the Moon,

3.69.s:
śārīramānasairduḥkhaistathā caiva vimucyate ..
kuṃkumenānulipyainaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 161 ..
3.69.d:
शारीरमानसैर्दुःखैस्तथा चैव विमुच्यते ॥
कुंकुमेनानुलिप्यैनं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 161 ॥
3.69.m: and is also freed from bodily and mental sufferings. / By anointing him with saffron, he is glorified in the world of the Sun,

3.69.s:
saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke tathā prāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
karpūreṇānulipyainaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. .. 162 ..
3.69.d:
सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लोके तथा प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥
कर्पूरेणानुलिप्यैनं वारुणं लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥ ॥ 162 ॥
3.69.m: and such a man attains supreme good fortune in this world. / By anointing him with camphor, he attains the world of Varuṇa,

3.69.s:
śārīrairmānasairdukhaistathaiva ca vimucyate ..
bhavanti vaśagāstasya tathaiva satataṃ striyaḥ .. 163 ..
3.69.d:
शारीरैर्मानसैर्दुखैस्तथैव च विमुच्यते ॥
भवन्ति वशगास्तस्य तथैव सततं स्त्रियः ॥ 163 ॥
3.69.m: and is likewise freed from bodily and mental sufferings; / women will also always remain under his control.

3.69.s:
dattvā mṛgamadaṃ mukhyaṃ yaśasā bhuvi rājate ..
dattvā jātīphalakṣodaṃ kriyāsāphalyamaśnute .. 164 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा मृगमदं मुख्यं यशसा भुवि राजते ॥
दत्त्वा जातीफलक्षोदं क्रियासाफल्यमश्नुते ॥ 164 ॥
3.69.m: By giving choice musk, he shines on earth with fame. / By giving nutmeg powder, he obtains the fruition of his actions.

3.69.s:
ramyeṇāgurusāreṇa tvanulipya janārdanam ..
saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke balaṃ prāpnoti cottamam .. 165 ..
3.69.d:
रम्येणागुरुसारेण त्वनुलिप्य जनार्दनम् ॥
सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लोके बलं प्राप्नोति चोत्तमम् ॥ 165 ॥
3.69.m: By anointing Janārdana with charming essence of agallochum, / he attains supreme good fortune and supreme strength in the world.

3.69.s:
tathā bakulaniryāsairvahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ..
bakulāgurumiśreṇa candanena sugandhinā .. 166 ..
3.69.d:
तथा बकुलनिर्यासैर्वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥
बकुलागुरुमिश्रेण चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना ॥ 166 ॥
3.69.m: Likewise, through the resins of the bakula tree, he gains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / By fragrant sandalwood mixed with bakula and agallochum,

3.69.s:
samālabhya jagannāthaṃ pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ..
ekīkṛtya tu sarvāṇi samālabhya janārdanam .. 167 ..
3.69.d:
समालभ्य जगन्नाथं पौण्डरीकफलं लभेत् ॥
एकीकृत्य तु सर्वाणि समालभ्य जनार्दनम् ॥ 167 ॥
3.69.m: anointing the Lord of the Universe, he gains the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice. / Combining all [these] into one and anointing Janārdana,

3.69.s:
aśvamedhasya mukhyasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
kāmagaḥ sarvalokeṣu vicaratyamaraprabhaḥ .. 168 ..
3.69.d:
अश्वमेधस्य मुख्यस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
कामगः सर्वलोकेषु विचरत्यमरप्रभः ॥ 168 ॥
3.69.m: he undoubtedly attains the fruit of the foremost horse sacrifice; / moving at will through all the worlds, he wanders shining like an immortal.

3.69.s:
yo'nulipyeta deveśaṃ kīrtitairanulepanaiḥ ..
pārthivāni ca yāni syuḥ paramāṇūni tatra .. 169 ..
3.69.d:
योऽनुलिप्येत देवेशं कीर्तितैरनुलेपनैः ॥
पार्थिवानि च यानि स्युः परमाणूनि तत्र ॥ 169 ॥
3.69.m: Whoever anoints the Lord of the Gods with the praised ointments, / for as many material particles as there are in that [unguent],

3.69.s:
tāvatyabdāni lokeṣu kāmacārī bhavatyasau ..
na dātavyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ atonyadupalepanam .. 3.341.170 ..
3.69.d:
तावत्यब्दानि लोकेषु कामचारी भवत्यसौ ॥
न दातव्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः अतोन्यदुपलेपनम् ॥ 3.341.170 ॥
3.69.m: for that many years he roams at will in the worlds. / No other ointment than this should be given, O foremost of the twice-born;

3.69.s:
anulepanamukhyaṃ ca candanaṃ parikīrtitam ..
anulipya jagannāthaṃ tālavṛntena vījayet .. 171 ..
3.69.d:
अनुलेपनमुख्यं च चन्दनं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
अनुलिप्य जगन्नाथं तालवृन्तेन वीजयेत् ॥ 171 ॥
3.69.m: and sandalwood is proclaimed the foremost of all ointments. / Having anointed the Lord of the Universe, one should fan him with a palm-leaf fan;

3.69.s:
vāyulokamavāpnoti puruṣastena karmaṇā ..
keśasaugandhyajananaṃ dattvā mṛgamadaṃ naraḥ .. 172 ..
3.69.d:
वायुलोकमवाप्नोति पुरुषस्तेन कर्मणा ॥
केशसौगन्ध्यजननं दत्त्वा मृगमदं नरः ॥ 172 ॥
3.69.m: by that action, a man attains the world of Vāyu. / By offering musk, which creates fragrance in the hair, a man

3.69.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
yacchate yastu gandhāni gandhayuktikṛtāni tu .. 173 ..
3.69.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
यच्छते यस्तु गन्धानि गन्धयुक्तिकृतानि तु ॥ 173 ॥
3.69.m: reaps the fruit of a sacrifice rich in all desires. / Whoever offers perfumes prepared through the art of perfumery,

3.69.s:
gandharvatvaṃ smṛtaṃ tasya saubhāgyaṃ ca tathottamam ..
cāmarairvījayedyastu devadevaṃ janārdanam .. 174 ..
3.69.d:
गन्धर्वत्वं स्मृतं तस्य सौभाग्यं च तथोत्तमम् ॥
चामरैर्वीजयेद्यस्तु देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ॥ 174 ॥
3.69.m: attainment of the state of a gandharva is remembered for him, as well as supreme good fortune. / Whoever fans the god of gods, Janārdana, with fly-whisks,

3.69.s:
tilaprasthapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
ekavastrapradānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt..175..
3.69.d:
तिलप्रस्थप्रदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
एकवस्त्रप्रदानेन सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्॥175॥
3.69.m: undoubtedly attains the fruit of the gift of a prastha of sesame. / By the gift of a single cloth, he attains all desires.

3.69.s:
kārpāsikaṃ vastrayugmaṃ yaḥ pradadyājanārdane ..
yāvanti tasya tantūni hastamātramitāni tu ..176 ..
3.69.d:
कार्पासिकं वस्त्रयुग्मं यः प्रदद्याजनार्दने ॥
यावन्ति तस्य तन्तूनि हस्तमात्रमितानि तु ॥176 ॥
3.69.m: Whoever gives a pair of cotton garments to Janārdana, / for as many cubit-length threads as it possesses,

3.69.s:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
mahārghatā tathā tasya sādhuveśodbhavo yathā ..177..
3.69.d:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
महार्घता तथा तस्य साधुवेशोद्भवो यथा ॥177॥
3.69.m: for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of heaven. / In the same manner, according as its costliness and fine tailoring are,

3.69.s:
sūkṣmatā ca tathā viprāstathā proktaṃ phalaṃ mahat ..
svargabhraṣṭasya vakṣyāmi vastradasya phalānyataḥ .. 178 ..
3.69.d:
सूक्ष्मता च तथा विप्रास्तथा प्रोक्तं फलं महत् ॥
स्वर्गभ्रष्टस्य वक्ष्यामि वस्त्रदस्य फलान्यतः ॥ 178 ॥
3.69.m: and according as its fineness is, O brahmins, such a great reward is declared. / Hereafter I shall declare the rewards of the giver of garments when he has fallen from heaven:

3.69.s:
śuklakstrapradānena śriyamāpnotyanuttamām ..
mahārajatadattena saubhāgyaṃ mahadaśnute .. 179 ..
3.69.d:
शुक्लक्स्त्रप्रदानेन श्रियमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
महारजतदत्तेन सौभाग्यं महदश्नुते ॥ 179 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of a white garment, he attains unsurpassed prosperity. / By a garment dyed with safflower, he enjoys great good fortune.

3.69.s:
nīlaraktaṃ vinā raktaṃ śeṣai raktairdvijottamāḥ ..
dattvā bhavati dharmātmā sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .. 3.341.180 ..
3.69.d:
नीलरक्तं विना रक्तं शेषै रक्तैर्द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
दत्त्वा भवति धर्मात्मा सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः ॥ 3.341.180 ॥
3.69.m: By giving [garments] of any other red hue, except for indigo-red, O best of the twice-born, / he becomes righteous, freed from all diseases.

3.69.s:
nīlaraktaṃ tathā jīrṇaṃ vastramanyadhṛtaṃ tathā ..
devadevāya yo dadyātsarvapāpairvimucyate ..181..
3.69.d:
नीलरक्तं तथा जीर्णं वस्त्रमन्यधृतं तथा ॥
देवदेवाय यो दद्यात्सर्वपापैर्विमुच्यते ॥181॥
3.69.m: [Not giving] indigo-red, nor what is worn out or worn by another, / whoever gives [pure garments] to the god of gods is freed from all sins.

3.69.s:
dukūlakapradānena vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ..
kauśeyāni ca vastrāṇi sumṛdūni laghūni ca ..182 ..
3.69.d:
दुकूलकप्रदानेन वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥
कौशेयानि च वस्त्राणि सुमृदूनि लघूनि च ॥182 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of fine bark-cloth, he obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / As for garments made of silk, very soft and light,

3.69.s:
yaḥ prayacchati devāya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
salomāni ca vastrāṇi yaḥ prayacchati dharmavit .. 183 ..
3.69.d:
यः प्रयच्छति देवाय सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
सलोमानि च वस्त्राणि यः प्रयच्छति धर्मवित् ॥ 183 ॥
3.69.m: he who offers them to the god attains the fruit of the horse sacrifice. / And the knower of dharma who offers woolen garments,

3.69.s:
kṛtāni vāravāṇāni so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
rāṅka vā mṛgalomāśca kadalyaśca tathā śubhāḥ .. 184 ..
3.69.d:
कृतानि वारवाणानि सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
राङ्क वा मृगलोमाश्च कदल्यश्च तथा शुभाः ॥ 184 ॥
3.69.m: fashioned as coats of mail, attains the fruit of the horse sacrifice. / Auspicious [cloths] of rāṅkava wool, deer hair, or banana-fiber,

3.69.s:
yo dadyāddevadevāya sośvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
nānābhaktivicitrāṇi cīnajāni navāni ca .. .. 185 ..
3.69.d:
यो दद्याद्देवदेवाय सोश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
नानाभक्तिविचित्राणि चीनजानि नवानि च ॥ ॥ 185 ॥
3.69.m: whoever gives to the god of gods attains the fruit of the horse sacrifice. / Beautiful, bright Chinese-born cloths, fresh and adorned with diverse patterns,

3.69.s:
dattvā vāsāṃsi śubhrāṇi rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ..
dattvā nistriṃśakaṃ mukhyaṃ śatrubhirnābhibhūyate .. 186 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा वासांसि शुभ्राणि राजसूयफलं लभेत् ॥
दत्त्वा निस्त्रिंशकं मुख्यं शत्रुभिर्नाभिभूयते ॥ 186 ॥
3.69.m: by offering such garments he attains the fruit of the Rājasūya sacrifice. / By offering a splendid sword, he is not overpowered by enemies.

3.69.s:
dattvā tadvaddhanurmukhyamagnimedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
yajñopavītadānena brahmadānaphalaṃ labhet .. 187 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा तद्वद्धनुर्मुख्यमग्निमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
यज्ञोपवीतदानेन ब्रह्मदानफलं लभेत् ॥ 187 ॥
3.69.m: Likewise, by offering a splendid bow, he obtains the fruit of an Agnimedha sacrifice. / By the gift of a sacred thread, he attains the fruit of the gift of the Veda.

3.69.s:
karṇapūrapradānena śrutiṃ vindati sarvataḥ ..
dattvā pratisaraṃ mukhyaṃ na bhūtairabhibhūyate .. 188 ..
3.69.d:
कर्णपूरप्रदानेन श्रुतिं विन्दति सर्वतः ॥
दत्त्वा प्रतिसरं मुख्यं न भूतैरभिभूयते ॥ 188 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of an ear-ornament, he acquires sacred learning on all sides. / By giving a splendid protective amulet-cord, he is not overpowered by spirits.

3.69.s:
kūrcaprasādhanaṃ dattvā sukhamatyaṃtamaśnute ..
kaṅkatasya pradānena virogastvabhijāyate .. 189 ..
3.69.d:
कूर्चप्रसाधनं दत्त्वा सुखमत्यंतमश्नुते ॥
कङ्कतस्य प्रदानेन विरोगस्त्वभिजायते ॥ 189 ॥
3.69.m: By giving a beard-grooming tool, he enjoys extreme happiness. / By the gift of a comb, he is born free of disease;

3.69.s:
rūpavāṃśca suveśaśca subhagassarvabhāgapi ..
vastrapradānādbhavati sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ .. 3.341.190 ..
3.69.d:
रूपवांश्च सुवेशश्च सुभगस्सर्वभागपि ॥
वस्त्रप्रदानाद्भवति सर्वकामसमन्वितः ॥ 3.341.190 ॥
3.69.m: and handsome, well-dressed, fortunate, and sharing in all blessings, / through the gift of garments he becomes endowed with all desires.

3.69.s:
vibhūṣaṇapradānena rājā bhavati bhūtale ..
ramyāṇi ratnacitrāṇi sauvarṇāni dvijottamāḥ .. 191 ..
3.69.d:
विभूषणप्रदानेन राजा भवति भूतले ॥
रम्याणि रत्नचित्राणि सौवर्णानि द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 191 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of ornaments, he becomes a king on the surface of the earth. / Charming, inlaid with gems, and made of gold, O best of the twice-born,

3.69.s:
dattvābharaṇajātāni rājasūyamavāpnuyāta ..
pratirūpakaratnāni na deyāni kadācana .. 192 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वाभरणजातानि राजसूयमवाप्नुयात ॥
प्रतिरूपकरत्नानि न देयानि कदाचन ॥ 192 ॥
3.69.m: by offering varieties of ornaments he attains the Rājasūya sacrifice. / Imitation gems should never be given.

3.69.s:
pādāṅgulīyadānena guhyakādhipatirbhavet ..
pādābharaṇadānena sthānaṃ sarvatra vindati .. 193 ..
3.69.d:
पादाङ्गुलीयदानेन गुह्यकाधिपतिर्भवेत् ॥
पादाभरणदानेन स्थानं सर्वत्र विन्दति ॥ 193 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of toe-rings, he becomes a lord of Guhyakas. / By the gift of foot-ornaments, he finds a place everywhere.

3.69.s:
śroṇīsūtrapradānena mahīṃ sāgaramekhalām ..
praśāsti nihatāmitro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 194 ..
3.69.d:
श्रोणीसूत्रप्रदानेन महीं सागरमेखलाम् ॥
प्रशास्ति निहतामित्रो नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 194 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of a waist-chain, he rules the earth girdled by the oceans / with his enemies slain; in this matter there is no doubt.

3.69.s:
hastāṅgulīyadānena paraṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyāt ..
tathaivāṅgada dānena rājā bhavati bhūtale .. 195 ..
3.69.d:
हस्ताङ्गुलीयदानेन परं सौभाग्यमाप्नुयात् ॥
तथैवाङ्गद दानेन राजा भवति भूतले ॥ 195 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of a finger-ring, he attains supreme good fortune. / Likewise, by the gift of an armlet, he becomes a king on the surface of the earth.

3.69.s:
keyūradānādbhavati śatrupakṣakṣayaṅkaraḥ ..
graiveyakāni dattvā ca sarvaśāstrārthavidbhavet .. 196 ..
3.69.d:
केयूरदानाद्भवति शत्रुपक्षक्षयङ्करः ॥
ग्रैवेयकानि दत्त्वा च सर्वशास्त्रार्थविद्भवेत् ॥ 196 ॥
3.69.m: From the gift of an upper-arm bangle, he becomes a destroyer of the enemy's faction. / And by giving necklaces, he becomes a knower of the meaning of all treatises;

3.69.s:
nāryaḥ suvaśagāstasya bhavanti dvijapuṅgavāḥ ..
śriyamāpnoti paramāṃ rājasūyaṃ ca vindati .. 197 ..
3.69.d:
नार्यः सुवशगास्तस्य भवन्ति द्विजपुङ्गवाः ॥
श्रियमाप्नोति परमां राजसूयं च विन्दति ॥ 197 ॥
3.69.m: women become obedient to him, O best of the twice-born; / he attains supreme splendor and obtains the Rājasūya sacrifice.

3.69.s:
karṇābharaṇadānena bhavecchrutidharo naraḥ ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti saubhāgyaṃ caiva vindati .. 198 ..
3.69.d:
कर्णाभरणदानेन भवेच्छ्रुतिधरो नरः ॥
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सौभाग्यं चैव विन्दति ॥ 198 ॥
3.69.m: By the gift of an ear-ornament, a man will become one who retains what he has heard; / he attains the horse sacrifice and obtains good fortune.

3.69.s:
mūrdhābharaṇadānena rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ..
mukuṭasya pradānena mūrdhanyo bhūtale bhavet ..199..
3.69.d:
मूर्धाभरणदानेन राजसूयफलं लभेत् ॥
मुकुटस्य प्रदानेन मूर्धन्यो भूतले भवेत् ॥199॥
3.69.m: By giving a head ornament, one obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice; / by the gift of a crown, one becomes foremost on the surface of the earth.

3.69.s:
catuḥsamudravalayāṃ praśāsti ca vasundharām ..
anuktānyapi viprendrā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca .. 3.341.200 ..
3.69.d:
चतुःसमुद्रवलयां प्रशास्ति च वसुन्धराम् ॥
अनुक्तान्यपि विप्रेन्द्रा वासांस्याभरणानि च ॥ 3.341.200 ॥
3.69.m: And one rules over the earth encircled by the four oceans. / Even unmentioned garments and ornaments, O foremost of vipras,

3.69.s:
dattvaiva devadevāya vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ..
dānaṃ sumanasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathaiva parikīrtitam .. 201 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वैव देवदेवाय वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥
दानं सुमनसां श्रेष्ठं तथैव परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 201 ॥
3.69.m: by giving to the God of gods, one obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma. / Likewise, the gift of flowers is proclaimed to be the best;

3.69.s:
alakṣmyā śamanaṃ mukhyaṃ paraṃ lakṣmīvivarddhanam ..
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ maṅgalyaṃ buddhivarddhanam .. 202 ..
3.69.d:
अलक्ष्म्या शमनं मुख्यं परं लक्ष्मीविवर्द्धनम् ॥
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं मङ्गल्यं बुद्धिवर्द्धनम् ॥ 202 ॥
3.69.m: it is the primary pacifier of misfortune, the supreme enhancer of prosperity, / auspicious, fame-giving, longevity-granting, beneficial, and mind-expanding.

3.69.s:
svargadaṃ ca tathā proktaṃ vahniṣṭomaphalapradam ..
puṣpālābhepi yo dadyādapi dūrvāṃkurāṇi ca .. 203 ..
3.69.d:
स्वर्गदं च तथा प्रोक्तं वह्निष्टोमफलप्रदम् ॥
पुष्पालाभेपि यो दद्यादपि दूर्वांकुराणि च ॥ 203 ॥
3.69.m: It is also said to grant heaven and to bestow the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma. / Even in the absence of flowers, whoever gives even dūrvā sprouts,

3.69.s:
sopi puṇyamavāpnoti hemadānasya vai dvijāḥ ..
puṣpālābhe'pi deyāni patrāṇyapi janārdane ..204..
3.69.d:
सोपि पुण्यमवाप्नोति हेमदानस्य वै द्विजाः ॥
पुष्पालाभेऽपि देयानि पत्राण्यपि जनार्दने ॥204॥
3.69.m: he too attains the merit of a gift of gold, O twice-born. / In the absence of flowers, even leaves should be given to Janārdana.

3.69.s:
patrālābhe jalaṃ dadyāttena puṇyamupāśnute ..
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ bhaktyā deyaṃ janārdane .. 205 ..
3.69.d:
पत्रालाभे जलं दद्यात्तेन पुण्यमुपाश्नुते ॥
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं भक्त्या देयं जनार्दने ॥ 205 ॥
3.69.m: In the absence of leaves, one should give water; by that, one enjoys merit. / Leaf, flower, fruit, [or] water should be given with devotion to Janārdana;

3.69.s:
tena lokānavāpnoti bhaktirevātra kāraṇam ..
bhṛṅgarājasya bilvasya cakrapuṣpasya ca dvijāḥ .. 206 ..
3.69.d:
तेन लोकानवाप्नोति भक्तिरेवात्र कारणम् ॥
भृङ्गराजस्य बिल्वस्य चक्रपुष्पस्य च द्विजाः ॥ 206 ॥
3.69.m: through that, one attains worlds—devotion alone is the cause here. / Of bhṛṅgarāja, bilva, and cakrapuṣpa, O twice-born,

3.69.s:
tathaiva bījapūrāṇi patrāṇi tu nivedayet ..
eteṣāmapi caikasya patradānaṃ mahāphalam ..207..
3.69.d:
तथैव बीजपूराणि पत्राणि तु निवेदयेत् ॥
एतेषामपि चैकस्य पत्रदानं महाफलम् ॥207॥
3.69.m: likewise the leaves of bījapūra one should offer. / Even the gift of a leaf of any one of these yields great fruit.

3.69.s:
patrāṇi tu sugandhīni pallavāni mṛdūni ca ..
tena puṇyamavāpnoti puṣpadānasamudbhavam .. 208 ..
3.69.d:
पत्राणि तु सुगन्धीनि पल्लवानि मृदूनि च ॥
तेन पुण्यमवाप्नोति पुष्पदानसमुद्भवम् ॥ 208 ॥
3.69.m: Fragrant leaves and soft sprouts— / through that, one attains the merit arising from the gift of flowers.

3.69.s:
ugragandhīnyagandhīni kusumāni na dāpayet ..
anyāyatanajātāni kaṇṭakīni tathaiva ca .. 209 ..
3.69.d:
उग्रगन्धीन्यगन्धीनि कुसुमानि न दापयेत् ॥
अन्यायतनजातानि कण्टकीनि तथैव च ॥ 209 ॥
3.69.m: One should not offer fiercely scented or scentless flowers, / nor those grown in another's dwelling, nor thorny ones,

3.69.s:
uktāni yāni dharmajñāścaityavṛkṣodbhavoni ca ..
tathā śmaśānajātāni yāni cākālajāni ca ..3.341.2 10 ..
3.69.d:
उक्तानि यानि धर्मज्ञाश्चैत्यवृक्षोद्भवोनि च ॥
तथा श्मशानजातानि यानि चाकालजानि च ॥3.341.2 10 ॥
3.69.m: nor those described, O knowers of dharma, as born from caitya-trees, / nor those grown in cremation grounds, nor those grown out of season.

3.69.s:
dānaṃ vivarjayedyatnātpuṣpāṇāmasugandhinām ..
sugandhīni manojñāni kusumāni dvijottamāḥ .. 211 ..
3.69.d:
दानं विवर्जयेद्यत्नात्पुष्पाणामसुगन्धिनाम् ॥
सुगन्धीनि मनोज्ञानि कुसुमानि द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 211 ॥
3.69.m: One should diligently avoid giving unscented flowers. / Fragrant, attractive flowers, O best of the twice-born,

3.69.s:
kṛtrimenopapādyāni gandhitāni sugandhinā ..
dhūpena eva vāsena caṃdanādyaiśca lepanaiḥ .. 212 ..
3.69.d:
कृत्रिमेनोपपाद्यानि गन्धितानि सुगन्धिना ॥
धूपेन एव वासेन चंदनाद्यैश्च लेपनैः ॥ 212 ॥
3.69.m: may be provided artificially scented with sweet perfume, / with incense, with perfumed powder, or with ointments such as sandalwood.

3.69.s:
kaṇṭakīnyapi deyāni śuklāni surabhīṇi ca ..
tathā raktāni deyāni jalajāni viśeṣataḥ .. 213 ..
3.69.d:
कण्टकीन्यपि देयानि शुक्लानि सुरभीणि च ॥
तथा रक्तानि देयानि जलजानि विशेषतः ॥ 213 ॥
3.69.m: Even thorny flowers may be offered if white and fragrant; / so too red flowers may be offered, especially aquatic ones.

3.69.s:
kuṅkumasya ca puṣpāṇi bandhujīvasya cāpyatha ..
campakasya ca deyāni tathā bhūcampakasya ca .. 214 ..
3.69.d:
कुङ्कुमस्य च पुष्पाणि बन्धुजीवस्य चाप्यथ ॥
चम्पकस्य च देयानि तथा भूचम्पकस्य च ॥ 214 ॥
3.69.m: The flowers of saffron and also of bandhujīva, / of campaka and also of bhūcampaka should be given,

3.69.s:
pītayūthikajānyeva māṣabanmālyajānyapi ..
mañjaryaḥ sahakārasya tathā deyā janārdane .. 215 ..
3.69.d:
पीतयूथिकजान्येव माषबन्माल्यजान्यपि ॥
मञ्जर्यः सहकारस्य तथा देया जनार्दने ॥ 215 ॥
3.69.m: those born of yellow jasmine, and those born of māṣabanmālya; / blossoms of the mango tree likewise should be given to Janārdana,

3.69.s:
mallikākundakusumamatimuktakameva ca ..
sarvāśca yūthikājātyo mallikājātya eva ca .. 216 ..
3.69.d:
मल्लिकाकुन्दकुसुममतिमुक्तकमेव च ॥
सर्वाश्च यूथिकाजात्यो मल्लिकाजात्य एव च ॥ 216 ॥
3.69.m: mallikā, kunda flower, and atimuktaka, / and all varieties of jasmine and mallikā,

3.69.s:
yāśca kupyakajātāśca kadambakusumāni ca ..
ketakīpāṭalaṃ puṣpaṃ bāṇapuṣpaṃ tathaiva ca .. 217 ..
3.69.d:
याश्च कुप्यकजाताश्च कदम्बकुसुमानि च ॥
केतकीपाटलं पुष्पं बाणपुष्पं तथैव च ॥ 217 ॥
3.69.m: and varieties born of kupyaka, and kadamba flowers, / the ketakī, the pāṭala flower, and likewise the bāṇa flower.

3.69.s:
evamādīni deyāni gandhavanti śubhāni ca..
karavīrasya puṣpāṇi tathā dhattūrakasya ca .. 218 ..
3.69.d:
एवमादीनि देयानि गन्धवन्ति शुभानि च॥
करवीरस्य पुष्पाणि तथा धत्तूरकस्य च ॥ 218 ॥
3.69.m: Such as these, fragrant and auspicious, should be given. / Flowers of the karavīra and of the dhattūra,

3.69.s:
kṛṣṇakuñcaṭakaṃ nārkaṃ naiva deyaṃ janārdane ..
sarvāsāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ jātiḥ śreṣṭhā tathā smṛtā .. 219 ..
3.69.d:
कृष्णकुञ्चटकं नार्कं नैव देयं जनार्दने ॥
सर्वासां पुष्पजातीनां जातिः श्रेष्ठा तथा स्मृता ॥ 219 ॥
3.69.m: black kuñcaṭaka, and arka must never be given to Janārdana. / Among all kinds of flowers, the jātī is remembered as supreme.

3.69.s:
jātīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ śuklājātiḥ praśasyate ..
kecidvarṇaguṇā deyāḥ kecidgandhaguṇāstathā .. 3.341.220 ..
3.69.d:
जातीनामपि सर्वासां शुक्लाजातिः प्रशस्यते ॥
केचिद्वर्णगुणा देयाः केचिद्गन्धगुणास्तथा ॥ 3.341.220 ॥
3.69.m: Even among all jātīs, the white jātī is praised. / Some are to be given for the quality of their colour, some likewise for the quality of their scent.

3.69.s:
anuktānyapi nāmāni tathā deyāni kānicit ..
deśe deśe yathā kāle yāni puṣpāṇyanekaśaḥ ..221..
3.69.d:
अनुक्तान्यपि नामानि तथा देयानि कानिचित् ॥
देशे देशे यथा काले यानि पुष्पाण्यनेकशः ॥221॥
3.69.m: Even unmentioned ones by name are also to be given in some cases, / whichever flowers in various regions and according to season

3.69.s:
gandhavarṇopapannāni tathā deyāni nityaśaḥ ..
sugandhipuṣpairyaḥ kuryātpūjāṃ madhuripornaraḥ ..222..
3.69.d:
गन्धवर्णोपपन्नानि तथा देयानि नित्यशः ॥
सुगन्धिपुष्पैर्यः कुर्यात्पूजां मधुरिपोर्नरः ॥222॥
3.69.m: are endowed with fragrance and colour, should thus be given constantly. / The man who performs the worship of the enemy of Madhu with fragrant flowers,

3.69.s:
tasya prasādamāyāti devaścakragadādharaḥ ..
dhanyāścorandhrimaṃjaryo dayitāstasya nityaśaḥ .. 223 ..
3.69.d:
तस्य प्रसादमायाति देवश्चक्रगदाधरः ॥
धन्याश्चोरन्ध्रिमंजर्यो दयितास्तस्य नित्यशः ॥ 223 ॥
3.69.m: to him the god bearing the discus and mace grants his grace. / Fortunate are the sprays of purandhri, ever dear to him.

3.69.s:
purandhripuṣpaṃ yo dadyādekamapyatha paṇḍitaḥ ...
tilaprasthapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 224 ..
3.69.d:
पुरन्ध्रिपुष्पं यो दद्यादेकमप्यथ पण्डितः ॥।
तिलप्रस्थप्रदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥ 224 ॥
3.69.m: A wise man who gives even a single purandhri flower / undoubtedly obtains the fruit of giving a prastha of sesame.

3.69.s:
purandhrimañjarīpuṣpasahasreṇārcayeddharim ..
agniṣṭomamavāpnoti kulamuddharate tathā .. 225 ..
3.69.d:
पुरन्ध्रिमञ्जरीपुष्पसहस्रेणार्चयेद्धरिम् ॥
अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरते तथा ॥ 225 ॥
3.69.m: Should one worship Hari with a thousand purandhri flower-sprays, / one attains an Agniṣṭoma and likewise uplifts one's family.

3.69.s:
karpūrapaṭavāsena purandhrimatha vāsitām ..
mahārajataraktena tathā sūtre niveśitā..226..
3.69.d:
कर्पूरपटवासेन पुरन्ध्रिमथ वासिताम् ॥
महारजतरक्तेन तथा सूत्रे निवेशिता॥226॥
3.69.m: Having scented the purandhri with camphor and fragrant powder, / and placed it on a thread dyed red with safflower,

3.69.s:
mālāpuṣpasahasreṇa yaḥ prayacchati bhaktitaḥ ..
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 127 ..
3.69.d:
मालापुष्पसहस्रेण यः प्रयच्छति भक्तितः ॥
अश्वमेधफलं तस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 127 ॥
3.69.m: he who offers with devotion a garland of a thousand flowers / has the fruit of an Aśvamedha; there is no deliberation needed here.

3.69.s:
śatena vājapeyasya phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
lakṣapūjāṃ tathā kṛtvā sarvānyajñānavāpnuyāt .. 228 ..
3.69.d:
शतेन वाजपेयस्य फलमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
लक्षपूजां तथा कृत्वा सर्वान्यज्ञानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 228 ॥
3.69.m: With a hundred, one undoubtedly obtains the fruit of a Vājapeya; / having performed worship with a hundred thousand, one attains all sacrifices.

3.69.s:
nandanādyeṣu mukhyeṣu devodyāneṣu cāpyatha ..
krīḍate devarāmābhirdevadundubhitaściram .. 229 ..
3.69.d:
नन्दनाद्येषु मुख्येषु देवोद्यानेषु चाप्यथ ॥
क्रीडते देवरामाभिर्देवदुन्दुभितश्चिरम् ॥ 229 ॥
3.69.m: And in the foremost celestial gardens such as Nandana, / he sports for a long time with divine women, celebrated by divine drums.

3.69.s:
dattvā nīlotpalayutaṃ kusumaṃ kuṅkumasya ca ..
tulyaṃ phalamavāpnoti baṃdhujīvasya ca dvijāḥ .. 3.341.230 ..
3.69.d:
दत्त्वा नीलोत्पलयुतं कुसुमं कुङ्कुमस्य च ॥
तुल्यं फलमवाप्नोति बंधुजीवस्य च द्विजाः ॥ 3.341.230 ॥
3.69.m: Having given a flower of saffron together with a blue lotus, / one obtains an equal fruit, and [likewise] with bandhujīva, O twice-born.

3.69.s:
suvarṇayavadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
dattvā nīlotpalaṃ viṣṇornātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. .. 231 ..
3.69.d:
सुवर्णयवदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥
